manifest.title: 200 个日常英语对话
manifest.description: 从日常小事开始，把想说的话练熟。先看中文，再回想英文。

sentences.zh: 你叫什么名字？
sentences.en: What's your name?

sentences.zh: 我叫珊迪。
sentences.en: I'm Sandy.

sentences.zh: 我也很高兴认识你。你是男性还是女性？
sentences.en: Nice to meet you too. Are you male or female?

sentences.zh: 哦，我有性别，我是女性。
sentences.en: Oh, I have a gender—I'm female.

sentences.zh: 这是你的头像吗？
sentences.en: Is this your profile pic?
sentences.context: 场景：询问对方的头像

sentences.zh: 真可爱，我喜欢你的头像。
sentences.en: Aw, so cute. I like it.
sentences.context: 场景：询问对方的头像

sentences.zh: 咱们能加个微信吗？
sentences.en: Can I add you on WeChat?
sentences.context: 场景：询问对方的头像

sentences.zh: 那算了。
sentences.en: Never mind then.
sentences.context: 场景：询问对方的头像

sentences.zh: 这个人是谁啊？
sentences.en: Who's this guy?
sentences.context: 场景：人的照片

sentences.zh: 哦我以为是牛顿呢。
sentences.en: Oh, I thought it was Newton.
sentences.context: 场景：人的照片

sentences.zh: 这个雕像在哪里？
sentences.en: Where's this statue?
sentences.context: 场景：人的照片

sentences.zh: 他们是谁啊？
sentences.en: Who are they?
sentences.context: 场景：有两个人的照片

sentences.zh: 他们两个关系很好吗？
sentences.en: Are they close?
sentences.context: 场景：有两个人的照片

sentences.zh: 这个雕像在哪个国家？
sentences.en: Which country is this statue in?
sentences.context: 场景：有两个人的照片

sentences.zh: 这是什么？
sentences.en: What's this?
sentences.context: 场景：桃子的照片

sentences.zh: 你喜欢哪个？
sentences.en: Which one do you like?
sentences.context: 场景：桃子的照片

sentences.zh: 你想吃一个吗？
sentences.en: Wanna eat one?
sentences.context: 场景：桃子的照片

sentences.zh: 哈哈你吃不了，我来吃。
sentences.en: Haha, you can't eat anyway—I'll have them.
sentences.context: 场景：桃子的照片

sentences.zh: 这个盘子里有几颗草莓？
sentences.en: How many strawberries are on this plate?
sentences.context: 场景：草莓和西瓜的照片

sentences.zh: 好甜啊，这个草莓和西瓜都好甜。
sentences.en: So sweet—the strawberries and watermelon are both super sweet!
sentences.context: 场景：草莓和西瓜的照片

sentences.zh: 这是什么植物？
sentences.en: What plant is this?
sentences.context: 场景：植物的照片

sentences.zh: 它开的花是什么颜色？
sentences.en: What color are its flowers?
sentences.context: 场景：植物的照片

sentences.zh: 它喜欢阳光吗？
sentences.en: Does it need a lot of sunlight?
sentences.context: 场景：植物的照片

sentences.zh: 我要多久给它浇一次水？
sentences.en: How often should I water it?
sentences.context: 场景：植物的照片

sentences.zh: 我现在要给它浇水吗？
sentences.en: Should I water it now?
sentences.context: 场景：植物的照片

sentences.zh: 你喜欢这个花盆吗？
sentences.en: Do you like this flower pot?
sentences.context: 场景：植物的照片

sentences.zh: 这是什么动物？
sentences.en: What animal is this?
sentences.context: 场景：海豹的照片

sentences.zh: 它是成年海豹吗？还是海豹宝宝？
sentences.en: Is it an adult seal or a baby seal?
sentences.context: 场景：海豹的照片

sentences.zh: 海豹生活在哪里？海里吗？
sentences.en: Where do seals live? In the ocean?
sentences.context: 场景：海豹的照片

sentences.zh: 我的小狗可爱吗？
sentences.en: Is my puppy cute?
sentences.context: 场景：小狗照片

sentences.zh: 你猜它几岁了？
sentences.en: Guess how old he is!
sentences.context: 场景：小狗照片

sentences.zh: 你知道他是什么品种吗？
sentences.en: Do you know what breed he is?
sentences.context: 场景：小狗照片

sentences.zh: 这个图片里的lbs是什么意思？
sentences.en: What does "lbs" mean in this image?
sentences.context: 场景：英文说明书表

sentences.zh: 你最喜欢什么树？
sentences.en: What's your favorite tree?

sentences.zh: 我最喜欢松树。
sentences.en: My favorite is the pine tree.

sentences.zh: 每年圣诞节我都会买一个小松树。
sentences.en: Every Christmas, I buy a little pine tree.

sentences.zh: 椰子树我也很喜欢。
sentences.en: I really like coconut trees, too.

sentences.zh: 我觉得椰子树的叶子特别漂亮。
sentences.en: I think their leaves are so beautiful.

sentences.zh: 那你最喜欢什么花？
sentences.en: How about flowers? What's your favorite?

sentences.zh: 我最喜欢玫瑰花，我妈妈也是。
sentences.en: I love roses the most—my mom does, too.

sentences.zh: 每年母亲节我都会给妈妈送玫瑰花。
sentences.en: Every Mother's Day, I get my mom roses.

sentences.zh: 你喜欢做饭吗？
sentences.en: Do you like cooking?

sentences.zh: 我自己做了沙拉呢，放了123456六种蔬菜
sentences.en: I made a salad myself—put in like six different veggies.

sentences.zh: 有生菜，芹菜，黄瓜，莲花白，胡萝卜，西蓝花
sentences.en: Lettuce, celery, cucumber, cabbage, carrots, and broccoli.

sentences.zh: 还挺好吃的呢！
sentences.en: It's actually pretty tasty!

sentences.zh: 好像有点淡了，我再加点盐
sentences.en: Hmm, a bit bland—let me add some salt.

sentences.zh: 哦，好像又有点咸了，我再加点水。
sentences.en: Oh wait, now it's too salty—I'll just add a splash of water.

sentences.zh: 哦好像又有点淡了，无语了，我不想吃了
sentences.en: Ugh, now it's bland again—I'm so over this, I don't even wanna eat it anymore.

sentences.zh: 看这张天空的照片！
sentences.en: Look at this picture of the sky!
sentences.context: 场景：天空的照片

sentences.zh: 我拍的！太美了！
sentences.en: I took it! It’s so beautiful！
sentences.context: 场景：天空的照片

sentences.zh: 我早上把这张照片发到朋友圈，有30个人给我点赞呢。
sentences.en: I posted it on my WeChat Moments this morning and got thirty likes!
sentences.context: 场景：天空的照片

sentences.zh: 还有16个人给我评论了，大家都说我拍的好美。
sentences.en: Sixteen people commented, too—everyone said it looks gorgeous.
sentences.context: 场景：天空的照片

sentences.zh: 我还发到微博了，我刚才看了一下，居然有65个人转发了！
sentences.en: I posted it on Weibo too—I just checked and sixty-five people reposted it!
sentences.context: 场景：天空的照片

sentences.zh: 天呐，我微博涨了50个粉丝呢，现在我有快100个粉丝了。
sentences.en: Oh my god, I gained fifty new followers—I'm almost at hundred now!
sentences.context: 场景：天空的照片

sentences.zh: 我要是每天都发一张图，说不定明年就成网红了呢。
sentences.en: If I post a picture every day, maybe I'll become an influencer by next year!
sentences.context: 场景：天空的照片

sentences.zh: 我要做水果沙拉哦！
sentences.en: I'm gonna make a fruit salad!

sentences.zh: 我先看看冰箱里有什么
sentences.en: Let me check what's in the fridge first.

sentences.zh: 有杏子，香蕉，哈密瓜，木瓜
sentences.en: There are apricots, bananas, cantaloupe, and papaya.

sentences.zh: 只有四种啊，我要再买点樱桃和山竹
sentences.en: That's only four kinds—I'm gonna get some cherries and mangosteens too.

sentences.zh: 你说我再放点坚果怎么样？
sentences.en: Do you think I should throw in some nuts too?

sentences.zh: 我加了点葡萄干，核桃，花生和腰果
sentences.en: I added some raisins, walnuts, peanuts, and cashews.

sentences.zh: 哇好丰富呀，我再放点酸奶。
sentences.en: Wow, it's so loaded—I'm gonna add some yogurt too.

sentences.zh: 太好吃了！
sentences.en: So good!

sentences.zh: 你好，今天想吃点什么？
sentences.en: Hi, what can I get for you today?
sentences.context: 场景：在快餐店点单，对方扮演顾客，你扮演快餐店服务员

sentences.zh: 好的，需要什么别的喝的吗？
sentences.en: Got it. Anything to drink with that?

sentences.zh: 好的，您是在这吃还是带走？

sentences.zh: 好的，一共是12.5美元，您是现金还是刷卡？
sentences.en: Alright, that'll be twelve-fifty—cash or card?
sentences.context: 场景：在快餐店点单，对方扮演顾客，你扮演快餐店服务员

sentences.zh: 这是您的收据和取餐号码，好了我们会叫号的，谢谢

sentences.zh: 你好
sentences.en: Hi.

sentences.zh: 我要3号套餐，带走。
sentences.en: I'll have the number three combo, to go.

sentences.zh: 算了，我还是就在这吃吧。
sentences.en: Actually, never mind—I'll have it for here.

sentences.zh: 谢谢

sentences.zh: 谢谢。
sentences.en: Thanks.
sentences.context: 场景：在快餐店点单，对方扮演快餐店服务员，你扮演顾客

sentences.zh: 我最近在看一个电视剧，可好看了。
sentences.en: I've been watching this show lately—it's so good!

sentences.zh: 叫《主角》，是刘浩存演的。
sentences.en: It's called《The Lead》, and it stars Liu Haocun.

sentences.zh: 可惜更新太慢了。
sentences.en: Too bad they drop episodes so slowly.

sentences.zh: 周一周二每天更两集，周三周四周五每天更一集，周六周日不更新。
sentences.en: It drops two episodes on Monday and Tuesday, one on Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday, and nothing on Saturday and Sunday.

sentences.zh: 啊啊啊我周末也想看，为什么周末不更新。
sentences.en: Ugh, I wanna watch on the weekend too! Why don't they drop new episodes on weekends?!

sentences.zh: 现在我看到25集了，一共48集，希望是好结局。
sentences.en: I'm on episode twenty-five now—there are forty-eight in total. I really hope it has a happy ending.

sentences.zh: 要是烂尾的话我直接气死。
sentences.en: If it has a bad ending, I'm gonna be so pissed.

sentences.zh: 我们今天去动物园玩了，看了好多动物。
sentences.en: We went to the zoo today and saw so many animals!

sentences.zh: 看了斑马猴子大猩猩老虎大象。
sentences.en: We saw zebras, monkeys, gorillas, tigers, and elephants.

sentences.zh: 哦还有两只大象宝宝呢。
sentences.en: There were two baby elephants too!

sentences.zh: 他们还不会用自己的鼻子，特别可爱。
sentences.en: They don't even know how to use their trunks yet—so cute!

sentences.zh: 哦我们还看了孔雀和狮子还有长颈鹿。
sentences.en: Oh, we also saw peacocks, lions, and giraffes.

sentences.zh: 不过孔雀今天没有开屏，有点可惜。
sentences.en: But the peacock didn't fan its tail today, too bad.

sentences.zh: 其实我还特别想看熊猫，但是这个动物园没有熊猫。
sentences.en: I was actually really hoping to see some pandas, but this zoo doesn't have any.

sentences.zh: 下次去四川的熊猫基地看熊猫
sentences.en: Next time I'll just go to the panda research base in Sichuan to see them!

sentences.zh: 我们现在在农场玩哦。
sentences.en: We're hanging out at a farm right now!

sentences.zh: 太有意思了，这里有鸡鸭鹅猪还有小羊。
sentences.en: It's so much fun—they have chickens, ducks, geese, pigs, and little lambs.

sentences.zh: 啊还有牛，我刚才还挤牛奶了。
sentences.en: Oh, and cows too—I actually just milked a cow!

sentences.zh: 我们还捡了5个鸡蛋，是一只母鸡刚才下的。
sentences.en: We also picked up five eggs—a hen just laid them.

sentences.zh: 哇刚才农场主说一会儿我们可以骑马。
sentences.en: Wow, the farmer just said we can ride the horses later!

sentences.zh: 这个马好乖呀，知道我害怕，走的慢慢的。
sentences.en: This horse is so sweet—it knows I'm nervous, so it's walking super slow.

sentences.zh: 哦刚才农场主说我骑的这个是驴。
sentences.en: Oh wait, the farmer just told me I'm actually riding a donkey!

sentences.zh: 我们三个人
sentences.en: Table for three, please.

sentences.zh: 你好，52号还没好吗？
sentences.en: Hi, is number fifty-two ready yet?
sentences.context: 场景：点奶茶，对方扮演店员，你扮演顾客

sentences.zh: 好的。
sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.context: 场景：点奶茶，对方扮演店员，你扮演顾客

sentences.zh: 可以多给我几个吸管吗？
sentences.en: Can I get a few extra straws?
sentences.context: 场景：点奶茶，对方扮演店员，你扮演顾客

sentences.zh: 你说我午餐吃什么呢？每天中午都不知道吃啥。
sentences.en: What should I have for lunch? I never know what to eat for lunch every day.

sentences.zh: 嗯....南瓜，玉米，红薯，你帮我选一个吧。
sentences.en: Hmm... pumpkin, corn, or sweet potato—pick one for me.

sentences.zh: 好吧。你说我再吃个排骨怎么样？
sentences.en: Okay then... what if I add some pork ribs too?

sentences.zh: 嗯...得再来点蔬菜，吃什么蔬菜呢？
sentences.en: Hmm... gotta have some veggies too—what kind?

sentences.zh: 嗯...白菜吧，做个白菜排骨汤。
sentences.en: Hmm... I’ll go with cabbage—I'll make cabbage and pork rib soup.

sentences.zh: 做好啦，我还洒了好多葱花在上面。
sentences.en: Done! I even sprinkled a bunch of chopped green onions on top.

sentences.zh: 太好吃了，我还吃了两个猕猴桃。
sentences.en: So delicious—I also had two kiwis.

sentences.zh: 如果你是个人类，你会喜欢吃全熟蛋还是半熟蛋？
sentences.en: If you were human, would you prefer hard-boiled or soft-boiled eggs?

sentences.zh: 那牛排呢？你会喜欢几分熟？一分？三分？五分？七分？全熟？
sentences.en: What about steak? How would you like it cooked—rare, medium-rare, medium, medium-well, well-done?

sentences.zh: 我比较喜欢七分熟。
sentences.en: I prefer medium-well.

sentences.zh: 那你会喜欢吃香菜吗？
sentences.en: Would you like cilantro?

sentences.zh: 我超级喜欢吃香菜，尤其是凉拌菜里面如果没有香菜，那就没有灵魂。
sentences.en: I'm obsessed with cilantro—especially in cold dishes, if there's no cilantro it just has no soul.

sentences.zh: 那你会喜欢吃榴莲吗？
sentences.en: What about durian?

sentences.zh: 我对榴莲一般般，但是我特别喜欢吃烤榴莲。
sentences.en: I'm not a big fan of durian, but I really love grilled durian.

sentences.zh: 好喜欢吃零食呀，我刚才逛超市买了好多零食。
sentences.en: I love snacking so much—I just went to the supermarket and bought a ton of snacks!

sentences.zh: 我买了5包薯片，一袋果冻，一个巧克力，还有一盒饼干。
sentences.en: I got five bags of chips, a bag of jelly cups, a chocolate bar, and a box of cookies.

sentences.zh: 我家里其实还有好多零食呢，都是一些膨化食品。
sentences.en: Honestly, I already have tons of snacks at home—mostly junk food.

sentences.zh: 零食虽然对身体不好，但是对我的情绪很好。
sentences.en: Junk food might be bad for my body, but it does wonders for my mental health.

sentences.zh: 有任何不开心的吃点零食就会很开心了。
sentences.en: Whenever I'm feeling down, having some snacks cheers me right up.

sentences.zh: 我现在回家了一边吃零食一边追剧真是太幸福了。
sentences.en: I'm back home now, and snacking while binge-watching my shows is pure bliss!

sentences.zh: 明天再开始减肥！
sentences.en: My diet officially starts tomorrow!

sentences.zh: 最近天气太热了，我每天都想吃水果。
sentences.en: It's been so hot lately—I want to eat fruit every single day.

sentences.zh: 今天买了西瓜、葡萄和草莓。
sentences.en: Today I bought watermelon, grapes, and strawberries.

sentences.zh: 昨天还买了好几斤桃子和梨。
sentences.en: Yesterday I got a few pounds of peaches and pears too.

sentences.zh: 其实我还想吃榴莲，但是太贵了。
sentences.en: I actually wanted durian too, but it's too expensive.

sentences.zh: 算了，冰箱里还有之前剩的橙子和苹果呢。
sentences.en: Oh well, I still have oranges and apples left in the fridge.

sentences.zh: 我家这水果丰富得都可以开水果店了。
sentences.en: With all this fruit at home, I could practically open a fruit stand.

sentences.zh: 边吹空调边吃水果边看剧真是太爽了。
sentences.en: Blasting the AC, eating fruit, and binging shows—it doesn't get any better than this!

sentences.zh: 我要学一下化妆，我刚看了一个博主的化妆教程，她教的可好了
sentences.en: I wanna learn how to do makeup—I just watched a beauty blogger's tutorial and she's so good.

sentences.zh: 不过我现在什么都没有，我要买粉底，眉笔，口红，眼线笔，腮红，修容
sentences.en: But I don't have anything right now—I need to buy foundation, an eyebrow pencil, lipstick, eyeliner, blush, and contour.

sentences.zh: 哦天呐，还不够，还有睫毛夹，睫毛膏，眼影
sentences.en: Oh wait, that's not all—I also need an eyelash curler, mascara, and eyeshadow.

sentences.zh: 都买好了，花了我快1000块钱。
sentences.en: Just bought everything—cost me almost a thousand yuan.

sentences.zh: 等明天我的化妆品都到了，我就化个妆试试。
sentences.en: Once all my stuff arrives tomorrow, I'm gonna try doing a full face.

sentences.zh: 那你说我是不是也得弄一下发型？
sentences.en: So do you think I should do something with my hair too?

sentences.zh: 要不我把头发烫卷再染个颜色？
sentences.en: Maybe I should get a perm and dye it?

sentences.zh: 算了，我本来发质就不好。
sentences.en: Never mind, my hair's already pretty bad as it is.

sentences.zh: 我晚上和朋友去吃了个69.9的海鲜自助，太划算了。
sentences.en: I went to a seafood buffet with my friend tonight—only Sixty-nine point nine kuai, what a steal.

sentences.zh: 虾、螃蟹，小龙虾，生蚝，全都是无限吃。
sentences.en: Shrimp, crabs, crawfish, oysters—all you can eat.

sentences.zh: 我吃了至少5个螃蟹，2盘小龙虾。
sentences.en: I ate at least five crabs and two plates of crawfish.

sentences.zh: 而且还有免费的小蛋糕，冰淇淋，饮料，还有各种炒菜。
sentences.en: Plus, they had mini cakes, ice cream, drinks, and all kinds of stir-fried dishes too.

sentences.zh: 哦而且这家的意面和披萨，也超级好吃
sentences.en: Oh, and their pasta and pizza were amazing too.

sentences.zh: 真的是我吃过的自助里最棒的。
sentences.en: Honestly, it's the best buffet I've ever had.

sentences.zh: 下周我还要去，这家店离我家可近了。
sentences.en: I'm going again next week—it's super close to my place.

sentences.zh: 完了完了，我上班要迟到了！
sentences.en: Oh no, no, no—I'm gonna be late for work!

sentences.zh: 我找不到我的车钥匙了!
sentences.en: I can't find my car keys!

sentences.zh: 我记得我昨天晚上放鞋柜上了呀，但是没有。
sentences.en: I remember I put them on the shoe rack last night. But they're not there.

sentences.zh: 天呐，竟然在沙发缝里！
sentences.en: Oh my god, they were stuck in the couch cushions!

sentences.zh: 等一下，我的手机呢？我刚刚还拿着……额，没事了。
sentences.en: Wait, where's my phone? I was literally just holding it... oh, never mind.

sentences.zh: 我正在用手机给你发语音呢。
sentences.en: I'm literally sending you a voice note on my phone right now.

sentences.zh: 不说了，我得赶紧出门了。
sentences.en: Gotta go! I gotta run.

sentences.zh: 我买了一个超漂亮的笔袋。
sentences.en: I bought a super cute pencil case!

sentences.zh: 是粉色的，而且可大了，可以装下6只笔，一个尺子一个量角器一个圆规。
sentences.en: It's pink and super spacious—it fits six pens, a ruler, a protractor, and a compass.

sentences.zh: 哎我橡皮怎么不见了，本来里面还有一个橡皮呢。
sentences.en: Wait, where's my eraser? I know there was one in here.

sentences.zh: 哦被我同学拿去用了，他天天啥也不带。
sentences.en: Oh, my classmate took it—that guy never brings anything to class.

sentences.zh: 我还买了5只荧光笔呢，我可喜欢买文具了。
sentences.en: I also got five highlighters—I'm totally obsessed with buying stationery.

sentences.zh: 我还买了好几个书皮，我要把我的书都包起来。
sentences.en: I bought a bunch of book covers too—I'm gonna cover all my textbooks.

sentences.zh: 放学了但是我现在还不能回家呢。
sentences.en: School's out, but I can't go home just yet.

sentences.zh: 因为今天轮到我值日。
sentences.en: 'Cause it's my turn to do classroom cleanup duty today.

sentences.zh: 我吃完晚饭啦，好撑啊。
sentences.en: Done with dinner—I'm so stuffed!

sentences.zh: 我要出去散个步。
sentences.en: I'm gonna head out for a walk.

sentences.zh: 河边真舒服，今天正好也不热。
sentences.en: It feels so nice by the river, and it's not even hot today.

sentences.zh: 好多阿姨在跳广场舞呢，好有活力。
sentences.en: So many aunties are out here square dancing—they've got so much energy!

sentences.zh: 真羡慕她们，我什么时候才能退休。
sentences.en: I'm so jealous—when will I ever get to retire?

sentences.zh: 今天的月亮也好圆呀。
sentences.en: The moon is so full tonight, too!

sentences.zh: 小时候每天晚上都能看到很多星星，现在好像很少了。
sentences.en: When I was a kid, you could see so many stars every night. Now, not so much.

sentences.zh: 我到家啦，出了一身的汗。
sentences.en: Back home now—I'm sweating buckets.

sentences.zh: 我养了一只小猫和一只小狗。
sentences.en: I have a cat and a dog.

sentences.zh: 小狗是只比熊，叫lucky，小猫是只英短，叫奥利。
sentences.en: The dog is a Bichon named Lucky, and the cat's a British Shorthair named Ollie.

sentences.zh: 小狗是公的，小猫是母的，它们都是三岁，都超级可爱。
sentences.en: The dog is a boy and the cat's a girl—they're both three years old and ridiculously cute!

sentences.zh: 每天我下班回来它俩都会来门口迎接我。
sentences.en: Every day when I get home from work, they both run to the door to greet me.

sentences.zh: 我超级爱它们，跟它们生活在一起太幸福了。
sentences.en: I love them to death—living with them is pure bliss.

sentences.zh: 不跟你说了，我现在要出门遛lucky了。
sentences.en: Anyway, gotta run! I'm taking Lucky out for a walk now.

sentences.zh: 哎，我的牵引绳怎么找不到了？
sentences.en: Wait... where did I put his leash?

sentences.zh: 哦找到了在床底下。
sentences.en: Oh, found it! It was under the bed.

sentences.zh: 我昨天晚上被蚊子咬了13个包！对,你没有听错，13个
sentences.en: I got 13 mosquito bites last night! Yeah, you heard me right—thirteen!

sentences.zh: 等下，我再数一下，1,2,3,......14个，我还漏了一个
sentences.en: Wait, let me count again... one, two, three... fourteen! I missed one.

sentences.zh: 讨厌的蚊子，我希望所有蚊子都从世界上消失
sentences.en: Stupid mosquitoes. I wish they would all just disappear from the world.

sentences.zh: 我现在感觉身上到处都痒
sentences.en: Now I feel itchy all over.

sentences.zh: 有一个包都被我抠流血了！
sentences.en: I scratched one of the bites so much it's even bleeding now.

sentences.zh: 我用创口贴贴上了
sentences.en: I put a Band-Aid on it.

sentences.zh: 气死我了，我要去买个电蚊拍，电死它们！
sentences.en: I'm so pissed off. I'm gonna get an electric fly swatter and zap them all to death.

sentences.zh: 以前我最讨厌苍蝇，现在我最讨厌蚊子
sentences.en: I used to hate flies the most, but now it's mosquitoes.

sentences.zh: 蟑螂我也讨厌，我之前在南方见过巨大的蟑螂
sentences.en: I hate roaches too. I've seen some giant ones in the South before.

sentences.zh: 你听过这个吗？有一只南方的蟑螂和一只北方的蟑螂第一次见面，南方蟑螂看了看北方蟑螂说：额，你是个，瓜子儿？
sentences.en: Have you heard this one? A southern roach meets a northern roach for the first time. The southern one looks at the northern one and says:“Uh… are you a sunflower seed?”

sentences.zh: 哈哈笑死我了
sentences.en: Haha, that kills me every time!

sentences.zh: 今天天气好好啊，我打算一会儿去公园玩。
sentences.en: The weather's so nice today—I'm gonna head to the park later!

sentences.zh: 不过我还没想好咋去呢，打车还是坐地铁呢...
sentences.en: But I can't decide how to get there, Uber or subway.

sentences.zh: 打车太贵了，但是坐地铁很烦，要转两次呢，要2号线转8号线再转4号线。
sentences.en: Uber is like way too expensive. But the subway's annoying, I have to transfer twice! Like Line two to eight, then four.

sentences.zh: 公交车太慢了，而且也要转车，45转197
sentences.en: The bus is too slow. And I still have to transfer. Like the forty-five to the one ninety-seven.

sentences.zh: 我还是打车吧，因为我要带个大风筝呢。
sentences.en: Oh, I'll just take an Uber, since I'm bringing a big kite.

sentences.zh: 我还要把我的野餐垫也带上，还有西瓜，可乐。
sentences.en: And I'll bring my picnic mat, watermelon, and Coke.

sentences.zh: 你说我要不要带个冰淇淋？哦会化的，算了。
sentences.en: Do you think I should bring ice cream? Oh, it'll melt, never mind.

sentences.zh: 天呐,打个车要80多，很好，还是坐地铁吧。
sentences.en: Oh my god! An Uber is over eighty kuai. Cool, subway it is.

sentences.zh: 要不我开车去吧。
sentences.en: Or maybe I'll just drive.

sentences.zh: 哦对了，我根本就没车呢！很好，还是坐地铁吧。
sentences.en: Oh, right, I don’t even have a car. Cool, subway it is.

sentences.zh: 我到公园了，人好多啊
sentences.en: I’m at the park now! So many people.

sentences.zh: 我今天要坐地铁去市图书馆。
sentences.en: I'm taking the subway to the city library today.

sentences.zh: 哇今天地铁真是人山人海。
sentences.en: Wow, the subway is packed like sardines today.

sentences.zh: 我估计这趟车我是上不去了，下趟也够呛。
sentences.en: I don't think I can get on this one—the next one looks impossible too.

sentences.zh: 啊终于上来了，我快被挤死了，连个空扶手都没有。
sentences.en: Ah, finally got on! I'm getting crushed here, and there's not even anything to hold onto.

sentences.zh: 这站下了好多人啊，我有座位了！
sentences.en: So many people got off at this stop—I got a seat!

sentences.zh: 真的服了自己了，我居然坐反了！
sentences.en: I seriously can't with myself—I was going the wrong way!

sentences.zh: 我现在下车了重新去对面坐。
sentences.en: I got off and I'm heading to the other platform now.

sentences.zh: 太搞笑了居然反方向坐了七八站!
sentences.en: It's so ridiculous—I rode like 7 or 8 stops, wrong way!

sentences.zh: 终于下车了，我找一下F口在哪
sentences.en: Finally got off—let me find where Exit F is.

sentences.zh: 我到图书馆啦。
sentences.en: I'm at the library now.

sentences.zh: 最近每天都好困啊，可能是因为天太热了
sentences.en: I've been so sleepy every day lately—it's probably because of the heat.

sentences.zh: 一到夏天我就容易困。
sentences.en: Summer always makes me so sleepy.

sentences.zh: 冬天太冷了也容易困，想在被窝里睡觉。
sentences.en: Winter's way too cold. It also makes me sleepy—I just wanna stay under the covers.

sentences.zh: 春天和秋天太舒服了，也容易困。
sentences.en: Spring and fall are so comfortable. They make me sleepy too.

sentences.zh: 我真是一年四季都困。
sentences.en: I'm sleepy all year round!

sentences.zh: 要是我不用上班，每天都能睡到中午12点就好了
sentences.en: If only I didn't have to work and could just sleep in until noon every day!

sentences.zh: 今天作业好多啊
sentences.en: I have so much homework today!

sentences.zh: 有三张卷子还有两个练习册要写。
sentences.en: Three worksheets and two workbooks to finish.

sentences.zh: 啊我真是看到数学卷子就头疼。
sentences.en: Ugh, just looking at this math worksheet gives me a headache.

sentences.zh: 6乘36除8等于多少？
sentences.en: What's 6 times 36 divided by 8?

sentences.zh: 789+45乘以22等于多少？
sentences.en: What's 789 plus 45 times 22?

sentences.zh: 67乘以9减去33除3等于多少？
sentences.en: What's 67 times 9 minus 33 divided by 3?

sentences.zh: 数学大题最讨厌了，我能拍给你吗？你告诉我答案。
sentences.en: Word problems are the absolute worst—Word problems are the worst! Can I take a photo and send it? You can tell me the answer.

sentences.zh: 不用了，我妈来了，她不让我问你。
sentences.en: Never mind, my mom just walked in, and she won't let me ask you.

sentences.zh: 这几天一直在下雨，搞的我心情都不好了。
sentences.en: It's been raining for days, and it's really getting me down.

sentences.zh: 好想出去晒太阳啊。
sentences.en: I just wanna go outside and get some sun!

sentences.zh: 外面下雨我就不想动，只想在床上躺着。
sentences.en: When it's raining outside, I just don't feel like moving—I just wanna stay in bed.

sentences.zh: 好想去一个最近不下雨的城市呆着，但是我没有钱。
sentences.en: I wanna escape to a sunny city for a bit, but I'm completely broke.

sentences.zh: 天气预报说还要再下一周的雨，啊，好烦啊！
sentences.en: The forecast says it's gonna keep raining for another whole week. Ugh, I can't take this!

sentences.zh: 你给我讲个笑话让我开心一下吧。
sentences.en: Tell me a joke to cheer me up.

sentences.zh: 谢谢你，一点都不好笑，我要睡觉了。
sentences.en: Thanks, that wasn't funny in the slightest. I'm going to sleep.

sentences.zh: 一年12个月里你最喜欢几月？
sentences.en: What's your favorite month of the year?

sentences.zh: 我最喜欢9月和10月，因为不热也不冷。
sentences.en: September and October are my absolute favorites—it's neither too hot nor too cold.

sentences.zh: 3月4月也不是很冷，就挺好的，我很怕冷。
sentences.en: March and April aren't super cold either. That's great. I can't stand the cold.

sentences.zh: 啊但是我也很怕热，所以7月和8月是我最讨厌的。
sentences.en: Oh, but I also hate the heat, so July and August are my absolute least favorites.

sentences.zh: 6月也不行，最近这几年6月就已经很热了。
sentences.en: June is out too—the past few years, June's already been sweltering!

sentences.zh: 5月其实也挺好的，五一可以放假。
sentences.en: May's actually pretty great too—we get time off for May Day holiday.

sentences.zh: 1月和2月其实也挺喜欢的，因为过年一般都在1月或者2月。
sentences.en: I actually really like January and February too, because Chinese New Year is usually in January or February.

sentences.zh: 11月和12月就挺冷了，最关键的是，11月12月都没有假期。
sentences.en: November and December are pretty chilly, but worst of all, there aren't any holidays.

sentences.zh: 还是10月最好了，又不热，又有国庆节，可以放假出去玩。
sentences.en: October is still top-tier though—great weather, and we get the National Day holiday to go out and have fun.

sentences.zh: 今天中午吃什么呢？我要点外卖不知道点啥。
sentences.en: What should I get for lunch? I wanna order takeout, but I have no idea what to get.

sentences.zh: 我想吃炸鸡和汉堡，但是昨晚刚吃过火锅，太罪恶了。
sentences.en: I'm craving fried chicken and a burger, but I just had hotpot last night—I’d feel way too guilty.

sentences.zh: 要不吃沙拉？健康是健康，就是看着一点胃口都没有。
sentences.en: Maybe a salad? I mean, it's healthy, but it just looks so unappetizing.

sentences.zh: 其实我还想喝奶茶，今天奈雪满30减10块，好划算。
sentences.en: I'm actually craving Bubble tea, too. Naixue has a ten yuan off thirty deal today—what a steal!

sentences.zh: 算了，我还是吃个米线吧。
sentences.en: You know what, forget it. I'll just get some rice noodles.

sentences.zh: 天呐米线的配送费竟然要6块钱？太贵了吧。
sentences.en: Oh man, the delivery fee for the rice noodles is six kuai? That's ridiculous!

sentences.zh: 算了，不点外卖了，我自己煮个玉米吃得了。
sentences.en: Never mind, I'm not ordering takeout—I'll just boil an ear of corn for myself instead.

sentences.zh: 啊躺在被窝里玩手机真是一天最幸福的事了。
sentences.en: Ah, lying in bed scrolling on my phone is honestly the best part of my day.

sentences.zh: 奥对了我要去给自己热杯牛奶。
sentences.en: Oh right—I'm gonna go heat up a glass of milk.

sentences.zh: 喝完牛奶了我又刷了一遍牙，今天刷了三次牙了。
sentences.en: Finished my milk, then brushed my teeth again—that's three times today!

sentences.zh: 最近也没啥好看的剧，我要看看小说了。
sentences.en: There are no good shows to watch lately, so I'm gonna read a novel instead.

sentences.zh: 我其实每天晚上都想早睡，但是太难了。
sentences.en: I always try to go to sleep early every night, but it's just so hard.

sentences.zh: 手机真的太好玩了，我几乎每天都玩到1点左右才睡。
sentences.en: My phone is just too distracting—I pretty much stay up until around one AM every night.

sentences.zh: 我今天一定要早点睡！
sentences.en: I'm definitely going to bed early tonight!

sentences.zh: 12点50了，我要睡觉了，晚安。
sentences.en: It's twelve fifty—time to go to sleep. Good night!

sentences.zh: 第一版西游记的电视剧是哪年播的？
sentences.en: When did the original 《Journey to the West》TV series air?

sentences.zh: 奥，我一直以为是九几年播的呢。
sentences.en: Oh, I always thought it aired in the nineties!

sentences.zh: 那甄嬛传是哪年拍的？
sentences.en: What year was Empresses in the Palace filmed?

sentences.zh: 居然是2010年！天呐，我以为是15年之后拍的呢。
sentences.en: Twenty ten?! Oh my gosh, I thought it was shot after twenty fifteen.

sentences.zh: 那那个时候孙俪才28岁啊。
sentences.en: So Sun Li was only twenty-eight at the time!

sentences.zh: 好厉害呀，那么年轻就演的那么好。
sentences.en: That's insane—she was so young and still gave such an incredible performance.

sentences.zh: 甄嬛传的主题曲是谁唱的？
sentences.en: Who sang the theme song for Empresses in the Palace?

sentences.zh: 太好听了
sentences.en: It's so beautiful!

sentences.zh: 歌词是谁写的？谁作的曲？
sentences.en: Who wrote the lyrics and composed the music?

sentences.zh: 真厉害。
sentences.en: That is seriously impressive.

sentences.zh: 电是19世纪发明的还是18世纪发明的？
sentences.en: Was electricity discovered in the 18th or 19th(eighteenth or nineteenth) century?

sentences.zh: 那电话呢？
sentences.en: What about the telephone?

sentences.zh: 那电脑和互联网呢？
sentences.en: What about computers and the internet?

sentences.zh: 那手机呢？智能手机应该是21世纪发明的吧？
sentences.en: What about cell phones? Smartphones were invented in the 21st(twenty-first) century, right?

sentences.zh: 人类好厉害啊，短短两三百年能发明这么多东西。
sentences.en: Humanity is incredible—we've invented so much in just two or three hundred years!

sentences.zh: 人类第一次登月是在19世纪对吗？
sentences.en: The first moon landing was in the 19th(nineteenth) century, right?

sentences.zh: 我小时候一直以为嫦娥真的住在月亮上呢。
sentences.en: When I was a kid, I honestly believed Chang'e actually lived on the moon.

sentences.zh: 小时候真的太傻太可爱了。
sentences.en: I was so silly and adorable as a kid.

sentences.zh: 我想养一只宠物，你觉得养什么比较好呢。
sentences.en: I wanna get a pet— What do you think I should get?

sentences.zh: 小猫小狗我都挺喜欢的，还有兔子羊驼。
sentences.en: I really like cats and dogs,—and rabbits and alpacas too.

sentences.zh: 我看有好多人养鹦鹉，都能和主人对话呢，太厉害了。
sentences.en: I see a lot of people have parrots—they can actually have conversations with their owners! That's so cool!

sentences.zh: 鹦鹉比狗还聪明吗？
sentences.en: Are parrots actually smarter than dogs?

sentences.zh: 还有挺多人养仓鼠和乌龟的，但是我不是很喜欢。
sentences.en: A lot of people keep hamsters and turtles too, but they're just not really my thing.

sentences.zh: 我可能挺适合养狗的，因为我很闲。
sentences.en: I'd probably be good at having a dog, since I have way too much free time.

sentences.zh: 我明天去宠物店看看吧。
sentences.en: I'll go check out a pet store tomorrow.

sentences.zh: 我要选一个和我有缘分的小狗狗。
sentences.en: I want to pick a dog that I really connect with.

sentences.zh: 我想换个发型了，我头发一直都是黑长直
sentences.en: I want to change my hairstyle—my hair has always been long, straight, and black.

sentences.zh: 我想烫成卷发再染个颜色。
sentences.en: I wanna get a perm and dye it a new color.

sentences.zh: 你觉得什么颜色好看？粉色还是棕色？我想在这俩里面选一个
sentences.en: What color do you think looks good—pink or brown? I'm deciding between the two.

sentences.zh: 额，还是棕色吧，粉色有点太引人注意了。
sentences.en: Hmm, I'll go with brown. Pink might be a little too much.

sentences.zh: 你说我要不要剪个刘海，朋友都说我剪刘海会好看，因为我额头挺大的。
sentences.en: Do you think I should get bangs? My friends say I'd look good with them 'cause I have a big forehead.

sentences.zh: 不过我不知道什么刘海适合我，齐刘海还是斜刘海？
sentences.en: But I don't know which style suits me—blunt bangs or side-swept?

sentences.zh: 嗯，我要好好考虑一下，周末再去做头发。
sentences.en: Hmm, I'll think it over and get my hair done this weekend.

sentences.zh: 等我做完了头发，拍照给你看。
sentences.en: I'll send you a pic once it's done.

sentences.zh: 我刚在一个店买咖啡，那个店员态度可差了。
sentences.en: I just bought coffee at this place, and the barista had such a bad attitude.

sentences.zh: 一般你一进店，店员都会说：您需要喝点什么？，但是她是说：喝什么？
sentences.en: Usually when you walk in, they say, "What would you like to drink?" But she was like, "What do you want?"

sentences.zh: 然后我说：一个小杯的卡布奇诺带走。她说嗯。
sentences.en: Then I said, "A small cappuccino to go." And she was just like "Mm."

sentences.zh: 真的好无语，难道就因为我点的小杯吗？
sentences.en: So annoying—was it 'cause I ordered a small?

sentences.zh: 小杯也要20块呢，点中杯或者大杯我也喝不完呀。
sentences.en: A small is still twenty yuan—I wouldn't even finish a medium or a large.

sentences.zh: 以后再也不来这家店了。
sentences.en: I'm never coming back here.

sentences.zh: 哇不过他家这个卡布奇诺好好喝啊。
sentences.en: Wow, but their cappuccino is so good though.

sentences.zh: 收回刚才的话哈哈，下次我还要来买。
sentences.en: Okay, scratch that—haha, I'll be back.

sentences.zh: 我被堵在高速上了。
sentences.en: I'm stuck in traffic on the highway.

sentences.zh: 前面的车排得都望不到头，好像是出车祸了。
sentences.en: There are cars backed up as far as I can see—it looks like there's been an accident.

sentences.zh: 关键是我现在肚子疼特别想上厕所。
sentences.en: And the worst part is my stomach's killing me and I really need to use the bathroom.

sentences.zh: 我早饭就不该吃昨天剩的那个虾，估计是坏了。
sentences.en: I shouldn't have eaten those leftover shrimp for breakfast—they probably went bad.

sentences.zh: 我现在离最近的服务区就10公里，但是我走不了。
sentences.en: The nearest rest stop is only 10 kilometers away, but I'm completely stuck.

sentences.zh: 不行了，我觉得我快憋不住了。
sentences.en: I can't—I don't think I can hold it much longer.

sentences.zh: 我现在忍的冷汗都下来了。
sentences.en: I'm literally sweating trying to hold it in.

sentences.zh: 啊啊啊前面的车终于动了。
sentences.en: Ahhh! The cars ahead are finally moving.

sentences.zh: 你说我买个摩托车怎么样？
sentences.en: What do you think—should I buy a motorcycle?

sentences.zh: 我在网上刷到一个摩托车可帅了，我想买个和那个差不多的。
sentences.en: I came across this super cool motorcycle online—I want something like that.

sentences.zh: 哦没事了，我看了一下价格要1万多。
sentences.en: Oh, never mind—I just checked the price and it's like, over 10 grand.

sentences.zh: 我还是适合骑自行车。
sentences.en: I'm better off sticking with my bike.

sentences.zh: 而且摩托车还要办牌照呢，好像还要考摩托车驾照。
sentences.en: Plus, you need to register a motorcycle, and I think you need a motorcycle license too.

sentences.zh: 哦而且买了摩托车还要买头盔呢，还要加油，都要钱。
sentences.en: Oh, and you gotta buy a helmet, plus gas... it all costs money.

sentences.zh: 我还是就骑自行车吧，还能减肥呢。
sentences.en: I'll just stick to my bike—at least it helps me lose weight.

sentences.zh: 这个周末我要和表弟一起去乡下看姥姥。
sentences.en: This weekend I'm going to the countryside with my cousin to visit our grandma.

sentences.zh: 姥爷去世以后，姥姥就一直一个人在乡下生活了。
sentences.en: Ever since our grandpa passed away, she's been living there all by herself.

sentences.zh: 我小时候可害怕姥姥了。
sentences.en: I was so scared of her when I was little.

sentences.zh: 姥姥以前是个工程师，她是个很严肃的人，对我可严格了。
sentences.en: She used to be an engineer, and she's always been super serious. She was really strict with me.

sentences.zh: 每次去她家，她都要问我成绩，还检查我作业。
sentences.en: Every time I visited, she'd ask about my grades and check my homework.

sentences.zh: 不过姥姥也会经常给我零花钱，给我做好吃的。
sentences.en: But she'd also give me pocket money and cook amazing food for me.

sentences.zh: 现在长大了，就不害怕她了，其实她很爱我。
sentences.en: Now I'm older. I'm not scared of her anymore. She really loves me.

sentences.zh: 我也很爱姥姥。
sentences.en: And I love her too.

sentences.zh: 我想做个演员，但是我爸妈不让
sentences.en: I wanna be an actor, but my parents won't let me.

sentences.zh: 他们希望我以后做个公务员。
sentences.en: They want me to get a government job instead.

sentences.zh: 我爸妈觉得演员歌手这种职业都不稳定。
sentences.en: My parents think jobs like acting or singing are just too unstable.

sentences.zh: 可能是因为我舅舅是个歌手，但是没有名气，也没有什么钱。
sentences.en: Probably 'cause my uncle's a singer, but he's not famous and doesn't really make much money.

sentences.zh: 但是我真的很想做演员，想成为一个大明星。
sentences.en: But I really wanna be an actor—I wanna be a big star.

sentences.zh: 我父母也希望我姐姐做个公务员，不过我姐姐自己创业了，现在是个大老板。
sentences.en: My parents wanted my sister to get a government job too, but she started her own business now she's a huge boss.

sentences.zh: 我姐姐是支持我考电影学院的，我很爱她，我也很爱我爸爸妈妈。
sentences.en: My sister supports me going to film school. I love her, and I love my parents too.

sentences.zh: 我会想办法说服他们的。
sentences.en: I'll figure out a way to convince them.

sentences.zh: 现在这些网盘真的太恶心了！
sentences.en: These cloud storage apps seriously suck!

sentences.zh: 我没有充会员下载东西就特别特别慢。
sentences.en: If you don't pay for premium, downloading stuff is painfully slow.

sentences.zh: 明明我网速很好，但是我下载一个3G的电影居然要20个小时！
sentences.en: My internet speed is totally fine, but downloading a threeGB movie somehow takes like twenty hours!

sentences.zh: 而且我刚才上传了一张照片，最多七八兆吧，传了半个小时。
sentences.en: Plus, I just uploaded a photo that was at most seven or eight megs, and it took half an hour.

sentences.zh: 啊哦，我发现我存储空间也不够了，非会员只有一个T的空间。
sentences.en: Oh wait, I just realized I'm running out of storage—free users only get one TB.

sentences.zh: 会员太贵了，一个月要30块钱
sentences.en: Premium is way too expensive—it's like thirty kuai a month.

sentences.zh: 算了，我删掉一点东西吧。
sentences.en: Forget it, I'll just delete some stuff instead.

sentences.zh: 哎呀，我领了一个优惠券，12块钱就可以充一个月的会员耶。
sentences.en: Oh wait, I got a coupon—I can get a month of premium for just twelve kuai!

sentences.zh: 太棒了，我赶紧把自动续费关掉。
sentences.en: Sweet! I gotta cancel auto-renew right away.

sentences.zh: 今天爸妈问我想不想要个弟弟或者妹妹，我说不想。
sentences.en: Today my parents asked if I wanted a little brother or sister, and I said no.

sentences.zh: 我觉得做独生子女挺好的，爸妈所有的爱都给我一个人。
sentences.en: I think being an only child is great—all my parents' love goes to just me.

sentences.zh: 我同桌有一个弟弟，他说爸爸妈妈很偏心弟弟。
sentences.en: The person I sit next to at school has a little brother, and he says his parents totally favor his little brother.

sentences.zh: 不过我也有个同学很爱自己的弟弟妹妹，他说他爸妈对他们三个都很好。
sentences.en: But I also have a classmate who adores his siblings and says his parents treat all three of them really well.

sentences.zh: 哦对了，我爸爸的老板家有两个女儿三个儿子呢。
sentences.en: Oh, and my dad's boss has five kids—two girls and three boys.

sentences.zh: 爸妈说怕我长大了会觉得孤单，但是我也有很多朋友呀。
sentences.en: My parents say they're worried I'll feel lonely when I grow up, but I've got plenty of friends.

sentences.zh: 不过其实如果妈妈能给我生个哥哥或者姐姐我是很愿意的，哈哈，但是这不可能。
sentences.en: But honestly, if my mom could give me an older brother or sister, I'd totally be down for that—haha, but that's not happening.

sentences.zh: 跟朋友约好了9点半逛街，现在快10点了她还没到。
sentences.en: I was supposed to go shopping with my friend at nine thirty, but it's almost ten and she's still a no-show.

sentences.zh: 她老是这样，上次我们说好3点一起看电影，她3点45分才到，我们就没看成。
sentences.en: She's always like this—last time we were supposed to catch a movie at three, she didn't show up until three forty-five so we couldn't even watch it.

sentences.zh: 现在已经10点10分了，她还没到。
sentences.en: It's ten ten now, and she's still not here.
It's ten fifteen already!

sentences.zh: 我刚给她打电话你猜她说什么？
sentences.en: I just called her—guess what she said?

sentences.zh: 她说她以为是晚上九点半，不知道是早上九点半。
sentences.en: She claimed she thought we meant nine thirty PM, not nine thirty AM!

sentences.zh: 我明明给她说了是早上九点半，而且晚上九点半商场都要关门了好不好！
sentences.en: I literally spelled it out for her—it was nine thirty AM! Plus, the mall closes at nine thirty PM, like hello?!

sentences.zh: 这次我绝对不会原谅她！
sentences.en: That's it, no way I'm forgiving her this time!

sentences.zh: 烦死了，我明天要去面试，结果今天脸上长了一颗巨大的痘痘。
sentences.en: Ugh, I have an interview tomorrow and of course I got this massive pimple on my face today.

sentences.zh: 就在我下巴上，红红的，特别显眼。
sentences.en: Right on my chin—all red and super noticeable.

sentences.zh: 而且我最近可能熬夜太多了，皮肤很油，毛孔也变大了。
sentences.en: And I've probably been staying up too late a lot lately—my skin's all oily and my pores are huge.

sentences.zh: 我刚才试了下用遮瑕膏把它盖住，结果显得更奇怪了。
sentences.en: I tried covering it up with concealer, but it just made it look even weirder.

sentences.zh: 我这个形象会不会影响我面试啊？
sentences.en: Do you think this is gonna affect my interview?

sentences.zh: 唉，我今晚必须早点睡，不能打游戏了！
sentences.en: Ugh, I gotta get to bed early tonight—no gaming!

sentences.zh: 希望我明天面试可以顺利通过，这家公司我特别喜欢。
sentences.en: Really hope my interview goes well tomorrow—I love this company.

sentences.zh: 好久没登我的微博小号，我要登一下看看。
sentences.en: I haven't logged into my Weibo alt account in forever—let me check it real quick.

sentences.zh: 哈哈，肯定有很多人给我发私信。
sentences.en: Haha, I bet I've got a ton of DMs.

sentences.zh: 天呐，有400多条新消息。
sentences.en: Oh my god, there are over four hundred new notifications!

sentences.zh: 。。。。无语，全都是官方小助手发的。
sentences.en: ...I'm speechless, they're literally all from the system bot.

sentences.zh: 我要把这个小助手取关了。
sentences.en: I'm so unfollowing this account.

sentences.zh: 好奇怪呀，我明明只关注了3个人，但是我主页上显示我的关注是5
sentences.en: That's weird—I know for a fact I only follow three people, but my profile shows five.

sentences.zh: 奥还有一个是超话，一个是我之前关注的一个明星但是账号被封了。
sentences.en: Oh, one's a fan community, and the other's a celebrity I used to follow whose account got banned.

sentences.zh: 我的粉丝居然掉了10个！本来就只有25个
sentences.en: I lost ten followers?! I only had twenty-five to begin with!

sentences.zh: 我今天刷到一个博主做的减脂餐看起来超好吃。
sentences.en: I saw a creator make this weight-loss meal today, and it looked so good.

sentences.zh: 她是放的鱼肉，西红柿，鸡胸肉，洋葱，菠菜一起炖的。
sentences.en: She just threw together fish, tomatoes, chicken breast, onions, and spinach and cooked them all together.

sentences.zh: 我现在打算复刻一下，我下午去超市把食材都买了。
sentences.en: I'm gonna recreate it—I went to the supermarket this afternoon and got all the ingredients.

sentences.zh: 哇我做好了，好好吃啊。
sentences.en: Wow, I just finished making it—it's so good.

sentences.zh: 我要加点辣椒，加辣椒肯定更好吃。
sentences.en: Gotta add some chili—that'll make it even better.

sentences.zh: 妈呀，辣死我了，我要吃点米饭。
sentences.en: Oh god, my mouth is on fire—I need some rice.

sentences.zh: 好撑啊，我肯定不会瘦的，人家博主都没有吃主食，但是我吃了好多。
sentences.en: I'm so full—there's no way I'm losing weight. The creator didn't even eat any carbs, but I ate a ton.

sentences.zh: 我太喜欢吃碳水了。
sentences.en: I just love carbs too much.

sentences.zh: 天呐，我今天半边脸都肿起来了。
sentences.en: Oh my god, half my face is swollen today.

sentences.zh: 是我的牙发炎了，可能是智齿吧。
sentences.en: It's a tooth infection—probably my wisdom tooth.

sentences.zh: 我从小最害怕的事情就是看牙医，那个钻牙的声音太恐怖了。
sentences.en: I've been terrified of the dentist since I was a kid—that drilling sound is nightmare fuel.

sentences.zh: 但是我现在牙特别疼，我先吃个布洛芬吧。
sentences.en: But my tooth hurts like crazy right now—let me take some ibuprofen first.

sentences.zh: 唉，我还是去医院吧，保佑我不要拔牙。
sentences.en: Um..., I should probably go to the dentist anyway. Praying I don't need an extraction.

sentences.zh: 我到医院了，人好多啊。
sentences.en: I'm at the dentist's now—so many people here.

sentences.zh: 轮到我了，我先进去了，一会儿跟你说。
sentences.en: They just called my name—I'm heading in, talk to you in a bit.

sentences.zh: 不想活了，医生说我的四颗智齿全都要拔掉。
sentences.en: I wanna die. The doctor said all four of my wisdom teeth have to come out.

sentences.zh: 好像快下雨了，天上都是乌云，我也没带伞。
sentences.en: Looks like it's about to rain—the sky's covered in dark clouds, and I didn't bring an umbrella.

sentences.zh: 哎呀，下毛毛雨了，一会儿可能就要下大了。
sentences.en: Oh, it's starting to drizzle—it's probably gonna pour in a bit.

sentences.zh: 我去对面的便利店躲一躲。
sentences.en: I'm gonna duck into the convenience store across the street.

sentences.zh: 妈呀我刚进来雨就变大了，瓢泼大雨。
sentences.en: Oh my god, the second I stepped inside, the sky just opened up!

sentences.zh: 天呐下冰雹了，好大的冰雹。
sentences.en: Holy crap, it's hailing! Those hailstones are huge!

sentences.zh: 现在又是打雷又是闪电的好吓人啊。
sentences.en: Now it's all thunder and lightning—it's honestly pretty terrifying.

sentences.zh: 雨停了
sentences.en: The rain cleared up!

sentences.zh: 出彩虹了耶！太漂亮了！
sentences.en: Look, a rainbow came out! That is so gorgeous!

sentences.zh: 下雪啦！这是今年的初雪耶！
sentences.en: It's snowing! This is the first snow of the year!

sentences.zh: 而且这个雪花好大啊，好漂亮。
sentences.en: And the snowflakes are huge—it's so pretty!

sentences.zh: 天气预报说会下一晚上呢。
sentences.en: The forecast says it's gonna snow all night.

sentences.zh: 明天一大早我就要去堆雪人。
sentences.en: First thing tomorrow morning, I'm gonna go build a snowman!

sentences.zh: 我哥他们要去打雪仗，我不喜欢，我就喜欢堆雪人。
sentences.en: My brother and his friends are planning a snowball fight, but I'm not really into that—I just wanna stick to building snowmen.

sentences.zh: 我要去找个胡萝卜给雪人当鼻子。
sentences.en: I gotta go grab a carrot to use for the snowman's nose.

sentences.zh: 你说用蓝莓当雪人的眼睛会不会有点太小了。
sentences.en: Do you think blueberries are a bit too small for the eyes?

sentences.zh: 我全都准备好了，就等着明天早上了，祈祷雪一定要下厚一点！
sentences.en: I'm all set—just waiting on tomorrow morning. Fingers crossed we get a really thick layer of snow!

episodes.title: 健身俩小时酸痛一整天

sentences.zh: 我昨天去健身房炼了两个小时。
sentences.en: I hit the gym for two hours yesterday.

sentences.zh: 今天我的肩膀,胳膊,大腿都特别酸。
sentences.en: Today my shoulders, arms, and thighs are all killing me.

sentences.zh: 可能是拉伸不够，也可能是我太久没锻炼了。
sentences.en: Probably didn't stretch enough, or maybe I just haven't worked out in way too long.

sentences.zh: 教练说让我休息两天再去练，今天就别去了。
sentences.en: My trainer said to take two days off and skip today.

sentences.zh: 我得坚持锻炼，我上周体检，医生说我肌肉太少脂肪太多了。
sentences.en: I gotta stay consistent—I had a checkup last week and the doctor said I have low muscle mass and my body fat is too high.

sentences.zh: 反正我打算以后一周至少要去两次健身房。
sentences.en: Anyway, I'm planning to hit the gym at least twice a week from now on.

sentences.zh: 以后每次锻炼我都要好好拉伸一下。
sentences.en: And I'm gonna make sure I stretch properly every single time.

sentences.zh: 最近只要一降温我就感冒，这身体素质真的越来越差了。
sentences.en: Lately I catch a cold every time the temperature drops—my body's really falling apart.

sentences.zh: 医生说我这是典型的免疫力低下。
sentences.en: The doctor said it's a classic case of a weak immune system.

sentences.zh: 最近都没好好吃饭，睡的也晚。
sentences.en: I haven't been eating properly lately, and I've been going to bed way too late.

sentences.zh: 医生让我11点前就睡，他说我的身体器官11点就要休息了。
sentences.en: The doctor told me to be in bed by eleven PM—said my organs need to rest by then.

sentences.zh: 但是太难了，我一上床就想玩手机。
sentences.en: But it's so hard—as soon as I get in bed, I wanna scroll on my phone.

sentences.zh: 你说我吃点维生素行吗？提升一下免疫力。
sentences.en: Do you think I should take some vitamins? To boost my immune system?

sentences.zh: 我吃了一颗，现在10点20，我把这把游戏打完就睡。
sentences.en: I just took one. It's ten twenty now—I'll sleep right after I finish this round.

sentences.zh: 我觉得我的眉毛好淡啊，你说我要纹眉吗？
sentences.en: I feel like my eyebrows are so light—do you think I should get them microbladed?

sentences.zh: 我一个同事的眉毛可浓了，特别好看。
sentences.en: One of my coworkers has such full eyebrows—they look great.

sentences.zh: 我再考虑一下吧，有点怕疼
sentences.en: I'll think about it—kinda scared of the pain though.

sentences.zh: 你说我要不要割个双眼皮呢 ，大家都说单眼皮不好看。
sentences.en: Do you think I should get double eyelid surgery? Everyone says monolids don't look good.

sentences.zh: 嗯，其实我还挺喜欢自己的单眼皮的。
sentences.en: Actually, I kinda like my monolids.

sentences.zh: 我觉得我的鼻子耳朵也都长得很可爱。
sentences.en: I think my nose and ears are cute too.

sentences.zh: 我最喜欢自己的额头了，我额头可饱满了。
sentences.en: My favorite feature is my forehead—it's so full and round.

sentences.zh: 虽然我眉毛很淡，眼睛也是单眼皮，但我还是很喜欢自己。
sentences.en: Even though I have light eyebrows and monolids, I still love myself.

sentences.zh: 今天我们公司新来了一个男同事，大家都说他超级帅。
sentences.en: A new guy started at our company today, and everyone's saying he's super hot.

sentences.zh: 我刚刚去茶水间碰到了，感觉长得挺普通的呀，就个子很高，快1米九。
sentences.en: I just ran into him in the break room—honestly, he looks pretty average to me. Just really tall, like almost 6'3"(six three).

sentences.zh: 不过他笑起来的时候有两个酒窝，这点还挺加分的。
sentences.en: But he's got dimples when he smiles, which is a nice bonus.

sentences.zh: 他人也挺有礼貌的，我喜欢有礼貌的人。
sentences.en: He seems really polite too—I like people with good manners.

sentences.zh: 我同事Linda觉得他长得像张凌赫，她是张凌赫粉丝。
sentences.en: My coworker Linda thinks he looks like Zhang Linghe—she's a huge fan of his.

sentences.zh: Linda想让我帮她要这个新同事的微信呢哈哈
sentences.en: Linda wants me to get his WeChat for her, haha.

sentences.zh: 我下午试试看。
sentences.en: I'll try this afternoon.

sentences.zh: 刚才在电梯里见到一个小女孩，超级可爱，才两岁。
sentences.en: I just saw this little girl in the elevator—she was so adorable, only two years old.

sentences.zh: 她一见到我就跟我说，你好。啊我的心都要化了
sentences.en: She looked at me and said "hello"—aww, my heart literally melted.

sentences.zh: 我问她你几岁了，她伸出两个手指头跟我说两岁，太可爱了
sentences.en: I asked her how old she was, and she held up two little fingers and said "two." So cute.

sentences.zh: 她穿的也很可爱，穿了一个艾莎公主的裙子和水晶鞋。
sentences.en: She was dressed super cute too—wearing an Elsa dress and sparkly shoes.

sentences.zh: 她眼睛大大的，皮肤也很白，脸肉嘟嘟的。
sentences.en: She had big eyes, fair skin, and these chubby little cheeks.

sentences.zh: 她爸爸妈妈也都长的很好看。
sentences.en: Her parents were a really good-looking couple.

sentences.zh: 她还特别喜欢按电梯，但是她太小了够不到按钮，她爸爸就把她抱起来按的。
sentences.en: She was obsessed with pressing the elevator button, but she was too short to reach it, so her dad picked her up to do it.

sentences.zh: 我决定要搬到郊区去住了。
sentences.en: I've decided to move to the suburbs.

sentences.zh: 我现在有三只小狗，我想要一个带院子的房子。
sentences.en: I've got three little dogs now, so I want a place with a yard.

sentences.zh: 之前我一直都在市中心住，一个小公寓就要6000块钱。
sentences.en: I've been living in the city center, where a small apartment costs six thousand.

sentences.zh: 郊区6000块钱可以租一个很大的房子呢。
sentences.en: Out in the suburbs, six thousand can get you a huge house.

sentences.zh: 这个房子离机场和火车站都挺近的，周围还有一个博物馆一个美术馆。
sentences.en: The place is pretty close to the airport and the train station, and there's a museum and an art gallery nearby too.

sentences.zh: 中介说这个小区离墓地也挺近的，问我介不介意。
sentences.en: The agent said the complex is also pretty close to a cemetery and asked if I minded.

sentences.zh: 我一点都不介意，我不怕鬼。
sentences.en: I don't mind at all—I'm not scared of ghosts.

sentences.zh: 反正鬼要是把我弄死了我也就变成鬼了，问题就解决了
sentences.en: I mean, if a ghost kills me, I'll just become a ghost too. Problem solved.

sentences.zh: 我现在租的这个房子快到期了，房东说要涨房租。
sentences.en: My lease is almost up, and my landlord said she's raising the rent.

sentences.zh: 本来是2500一个月的，要涨到3000，我觉得太贵了。
sentences.en: It was twenty-five hundred a month, now she wants three thousand—I think that's too much.

sentences.zh: 但是这个房子地段真的特别好，离我公司很近，离地铁站和公交站也很近。
sentences.en: But the location is seriously great—super close to my office, and near both the subway and bus stops.

sentences.zh: 而且小区旁边就是商场，商场后面还有个大公园。
sentences.en: Plus there's a mall right next to the complex, and a big park behind the mall.

sentences.zh: 而且这个小区周围还有银行，药店，警察局和消防站。
sentences.en: And the neighborhood has everything—a bank, a pharmacy, a police station, and a fire station.

sentences.zh: 哦这附近还有一个特别棒的夜店，真的很完美。
sentences.en: Oh, and there's an awesome nightclub nearby too—it's pretty much perfect.

sentences.zh: 我再跟房东聊一下吧，看能不能便宜点。
sentences.en: I'll talk to the landlord again and see if she can go any lower.

sentences.zh: 她说最低2800，我觉得也能接受，毕竟这个位置真的太好了。
sentences.en: She said the lowest she can do is twenty-eight hundred, I think I can live with that — the location's just too good.

sentences.zh: 我今天测了一下我的 MBTI ，你猜是什么？。
sentences.en: I took the MBTI test today—guess what I got?

sentences.zh: ENFP, 我居然是个 E 人，我觉得我挺内向的呀。
sentences.en: ENFP—I'm actually an E? I always thought I was pretty introverted.

sentences.zh: 我平时最喜欢自己在家拼乐高了。
sentences.en: I usually love staying home and building LEGO by myself.

sentences.zh: 不过我跟大家在一起的时候虽然话不多，但是我挺开心的，所以我应该是喜欢社交的。
sentences.en: But when I'm with people, even though I don't talk much, I do enjoy it—so I guess I do like socializing.

sentences.zh: 不过有很多陌生人的那种社交场合我还是很抵触的。
sentences.en: But I still really dread social situations with a ton of strangers.

sentences.zh: 看来我只是喜欢跟熟人社交。
sentences.en: Seems like I only like socializing with people I know.

sentences.zh: 我朋友说我是那种刚认识的时候觉得很文静，时间久了就变成疯子的人哈哈
sentences.en: My friend says I'm the type who seems quiet when you first meet me, but turns into a total goofball once you get to know me—haha.

sentences.zh: 我这应该是慢热吧。
sentences.en: I guess I'm just slow to warm up.

sentences.zh: 快下班了，我们今晚要去吃烤肉！
sentences.en: I'm almost off work—we're going for BBQ tonight!

sentences.zh: 我要点牛排, 肥牛、五花肉,烤肠，天呐我口水都快流下来了
sentences.en: I'm gonna order steak, beef slices, pork belly, and grilled sausages—oh man, I'm already drooling.

sentences.zh: 我已经快两周没吃过烤肉了。啊啊啊，怎么还不下班！
sentences.en: I haven't had BBQ in almost two weeks. Argh, why isn't work over yet?!

sentences.zh: 我们到店里了，我要了两碟蒜片，我吃烤肉超喜欢配蒜。
sentences.en: We're at the restaurant now—I asked for two plates of garlic slices, I love having garlic with my BBQ.

sentences.zh: 这家服务好好，服务员一直在帮我们烤肉，都不用自己动手。
sentences.en: The service here is great—our server is grilling everything for us—we don't even have to lift a finger!

sentences.zh: 他们家泡菜也很好吃，蘸料味道也很好，生菜也很新鲜。
sentences.en: Their kimchi is delicious too, the dipping sauce is on point, and the lettuce is super fresh.

sentences.zh: 哇！他们家南瓜粥也好好喝。
sentences.en: Wow! Their pumpkin porridge is amazing too.

sentences.zh: 好棒的店啊，难怪评分那么高，一会儿我也要给他们五星好评。
sentences.en: Such a great place—no wonder the ratings are so high. I'm gonna give them five stars too.

sentences.zh: 如果你是个人，你会喜欢喝美式还是拿铁？
sentences.en: If you were human, would you prefer Americanos or lattes?

sentences.zh: 我不喜欢美式，苦苦的，尤其是热美式，和中药有什么区别？
sentences.en: I don't like Americanos—they're so bitter. Hot Americanos especially—what's the difference between that and Chinese medicine?

sentences.zh: 冰美式还稍微好点。
sentences.en: Iced Americanos are a little better.

sentences.zh: 不过还是拿铁最好喝，咖啡就得加糖加奶。
sentences.en: But lattes are still the best—Coffee just needs some sugar and milk.

sentences.zh: 我每次都要加两包糖。
sentences.en: I always add two packets of sugar.

sentences.zh: 我真的好喜欢喝拿铁，不过每天喝咖啡好像对身体不太好。
sentences.en: I really love lattes, but drinking coffee every day doesn't seem great for your health.

sentences.zh: 我以前每天都喝，现在就周末喝，平常都喝酸奶。
sentences.en: I used to have it daily, now I only drink it on weekends and stick to yogurt on weekdays.

sentences.zh: 酸奶我也挺喜欢的，再加点坚果，比如核桃杏仁之类的。
sentences.en: I like yogurt too, especially with some nuts like walnuts and almonds.

sentences.zh: 我决定要跟我男朋友分手了。
sentences.en: I've decided to break up with my boyfriend.

sentences.zh: 他太敏感了，而且脾气特别暴躁。
sentences.en: He's way too sensitive and has a really quick temper.

sentences.zh: 我们现在是异地恋，大概3个月才能见一次，每天只能视频。
sentences.en: We're doing long-distance—we only get to see each other every three months or so, and we just video call every day.

sentences.zh: 我们这段时间吵架吵了至少5次，每次都是他先开始的。
sentences.en: We've fought at least five times lately, and he's the one who starts it every single time.

sentences.zh: 而且他每次吵完架都会跟我冷战好几天。
sentences.en: Plus, after every fight, he gives me the silent treatment for days.

sentences.zh: 我真的觉得这样太消耗了，我不想继续了。
sentences.en: I just find it so emotionally draining—I don't wanna do this anymore.

sentences.zh: 我觉得谈恋爱是为了让彼此高兴的，既然大家都不开心，为什么要在一起呢？
sentences.en: I feel like relationships should make both people happy. If we're both miserable, what's the point of staying together?

sentences.zh: 不过我会先好好跟他谈谈的。
sentences.en: But I'm gonna have a serious talk with him first.

sentences.zh: 刚才我和朋友吃了个早午餐，快把我撑死了。
sentences.en: I just had brunch with my friend—I'm so stuffed.

sentences.zh: 我们两个人吃了一个披萨一份意面，一个汉堡，一个蔬菜沙拉，一个煎蛋卷，一个罗宋汤，还有一份烤鸡翅，里面有6个鸡翅。
sentences.en: The two of us had a pizza, a pasta, a burger, a veggie salad, an omelette, a borscht soup, and a plate of grilled chicken wings—six wings in there.

sentences.zh: 不过超级便宜，他们是新店开业，我们两个人AA嘛，一个人才60块钱。
sentences.en: But it was super cheap—it's a new place that just opened, we split the bill, so it was only sixty kuai each.

sentences.zh: 我们现在要去超市逛一逛，消消食。
sentences.en: We're gonna walk around the supermarket now to walk off all that food.

sentences.zh: 但是我们找了半天还没找到超市入口在哪呢。
sentences.en: But we've been looking forever and still can't find the entrance.

sentences.zh: 这边都是写字楼，也没有商场，到底哪有超市呢？
sentences.en: It's all office buildings around here—there's not even a mall. Where's the supermarket?

sentences.zh: 哦找到了要坐扶梯下去呢，在负一层。
sentences.en: Oh, found it! We have to take the escalator down—it's on B1.

sentences.zh: 我一路狂奔到车站，还是晚了五秒钟。
sentences.en: I sprinted all the way to the bus stop, but I was still five seconds too late.

sentences.zh: 下一班车要等十分钟呢，我上班肯定迟到了。
sentences.en: The next bus won't be here for ten minutes—I'm definitely gonna be late for work.

sentences.zh: 现在上班高峰期也不好打车，周围也没有地铁。
sentences.en: It's morning rush hour, so it's super hard to get a ride, and there's no subway around here either.

sentences.zh: 哦而且我今天出门太着急，连工牌都没带。
sentences.en: Oh, and I was in such a rush this morning I even forgot my work badge.

sentences.zh: 天呐我手机也快没电了，一会儿还得扫码付钱呢。
sentences.en: And my phone's about to die—and I still have to scan to pay for the ride!

sentences.zh: 没事了我在包里翻到了几个硬币。
sentences.en: Never mind, I dug around in my bag and found some coins.

sentences.zh: 终于到公司了，好神奇，我居然没迟到！
sentences.en: Finally made it to the office—it's a miracle, I'm actually on time!

sentences.zh: 我买了一个自行车哦！二手的，才花了100块钱。
sentences.en: I bought a bike! Secondhand—only cost me one hundred kuai.

sentences.zh: 以后我再也不用骑共享单车了。
sentences.en: No more shared bikes for me!

sentences.zh: 我今天就要骑我自己的车去上班。
sentences.en: I'm riding my own bike to work today.

sentences.zh: 而且我的车是绿色的，超级好看，看起来非常春天。
sentences.en: And it's green—super pretty, it gives off such a spring vibe!

sentences.zh: 吓死我了，我刚才骑着骑着速度太快了我就捏刹车嘛，居然没反应。
sentences.en: That scared the crap out of me—I was riding pretty fast, so I hit the brakes, and nothing happened!

sentences.zh: 太吓人了，我最后用脚把车刹住的。
sentences.en: It was terrifying—I literally had to use my feet to stop the bike!

sentences.zh: 真是便宜没好货！怪不得100块钱就卖给我了。
sentences.en: You get what you pay for! No wonder they sold it to me for one hundred.

sentences.zh: 等下班了我要找个地方去修一下这个刹车。
sentences.en: I gotta find a place to get these brakes fixed after work.

sentences.zh: 我最近在学钢琴哦
sentences.en: I've been learning to play the piano lately!

sentences.zh: 成年人学钢琴比小孩便宜多了。
sentences.en: Piano lessons for adults are way cheaper than for kids.

sentences.zh: 我这个是每周2节课，一个月才600块钱，一共上两年。
sentences.en: I have two lessons a week for only six hundred kuai a month, and the whole program is two years.

sentences.zh: 不过我感觉我的无名指和小指都没什么力气。
sentences.en: But I feel like my ring finger and pinky are super weak.

sentences.zh: 我中指的力量最强，大拇指和食指还行吧。
sentences.en: My middle finger is the strongest, and my thumb and index finger are decent.

sentences.zh: 而且我小拇指可短了，估计很难成为一个钢琴大师。
sentences.en: Plus, my pinky is so short—I'm probably never gonna be a virtuoso.

sentences.zh: 不过我本来也没有想成为一个钢琴大师。
sentences.en: But I was never trying to be a virtuoso anyway.

sentences.zh: 我学钢琴是因为弹琴的时候很开心。
sentences.en: I'm just learning because playing brings me so much joy!

sentences.zh: 老师说我还挺有音乐天赋的呢。
sentences.en: My teacher actually said I'm pretty musical!

sentences.zh: 每天早上7点闹钟一响我就想把手机砸了。
sentences.en: Every morning when my alarm goes off at seven, I just wanna smash my phone.

sentences.zh: 啊我什么时候才能每天睡到自然醒。
sentences.en: Ugh, when will I ever get to just sleep in every day?

sentences.zh: 我要起床洗漱了，再不起来就要迟到了。
sentences.en: I gotta get up and get ready—if I don't get moving, I'll be late.

sentences.zh: 我为了多睡一点，每天妆都不化的，就洗个脸刷个牙就出门了。
sentences.en: Just to sleep a few extra minutes, I don't even wear makeup—I just wash my face, brush my teeth, and head out the door.

sentences.zh: 早餐我也是在小区门口买了边走边吃。
sentences.en: I just grab breakfast from the place outside my apartment and eat on the go.

sentences.zh: 妈呀今天这个豆浆好难喝啊。
sentences.en: Ew, this soy milk tastes terrible today!

sentences.zh: 今天的包子也不太新鲜，可能都是昨天剩的。
sentences.en: The steamed buns aren't fresh either—they're probably leftovers from yesterday.

sentences.zh: 到公司啦，卡点到，刷工牌的时候闸机上正好显示8点。
sentences.en: Made it to work right on the dot! When I scanned my badge, the gate showed exactly eight o'clock.

sentences.zh: 我要去洗澡了，今天要把头发也洗了。
sentences.en: I'm gonna take a shower—gotta wash my hair today, too.

sentences.zh: 我一般是两天洗一次头。
sentences.en: I usually wash my hair every other day.

sentences.zh: 我今天用的新沐浴液，是薰衣草味的，好香呀。
sentences.en: I used my new body wash today—it's lavender-scented and smells so good!

sentences.zh: 我每次洗头都掉十几根头发，这正常吗？
sentences.en: I lose like a dozen strands of hair every time I wash my hair—is that normal?

sentences.zh: 啊，吹头发太累了，每次至少要吹20分钟，我头发太多太长了。
sentences.en: Ugh, blow-drying my hair is such a chore—it takes at least twenty minutes because my hair is so thick and long.

sentences.zh: 啊差点忘了，我今天还要做个面膜呢。
sentences.en: Oh, I almost forgot—I need to put on a face mask today, too.

sentences.zh: 我的脸真大，每次用面膜都盖不住整张脸。
sentences.en: My face is so big that sheet masks never cover my whole face!

sentences.zh: 我又涂了点面霜和眼霜，皮肤看起来好好呀。
sentences.en: I put on some moisturizer and eye cream, too—my skin looks amazing!

sentences.zh: 我买的烘干机和饮水机到啦！
sentences.en: My dryer and water dispenser just arrived!

sentences.zh: 好快呀，昨天晚上买的今天就到了。
sentences.en: That was so fast—I ordered them last night and they're already here.

sentences.zh: 哇这个饮水机好好看，果然还是得买黑色的。
sentences.en: Wow, this water dispenser looks amazing—black was definitely the right move.

sentences.zh: 烘干机咋用啊？我以前从来没用过。
sentences.en: How do you even use a dryer? I've never used one before.

sentences.zh: 我看看说明书吧。
sentences.en: Let me check the manual real quick.

sentences.zh: 天呐烘干机也太伟大了！
sentences.en: Oh my gosh, the dryer is such a game changer!

sentences.zh: 才半个小时我的衣服就全都干了而且一点都不皱。
sentences.en: In just half an hour, all my clothes were totally dry and not even wrinkled!

sentences.zh: 我都不需要买衣架了，以后都不用晾衣服了
sentences.en: I don't even need hangers anymore—I don't have to hang my clothes out to dry anymore!

sentences.zh: 不过天气好的时候还是可以把衣服晾到阳台去晒晒太阳。
sentences.en: But on nice days, I can still hang them out on the balcony to get some sun.

sentences.zh: 我买了四个超可爱的马克杯。
sentences.en: I bought four super cute mugs!

sentences.zh: 不过我家里没有专门的杯架，只能放在电视柜上了。
sentences.en: But I don't have a place to display my mugs, so I'll just put them on the TV stand.

sentences.zh: 电视柜和电视都是黑色的，和这几个马克杯还挺配的呢。
sentences.en: The TV stand and the TV are both black, so they actually go really well with the mugs.

sentences.zh: 以后朋友来家里就可以用我新买的杯子啦。
sentences.en: Next time friends come over, they can use my new mugs!

sentences.zh: 我打算再买个摇椅，沙发太小了，只能坐下3个人。
sentences.en: I'm thinking about getting a rocking chair, too—my couch is so small, it only seats three people.

sentences.zh: 或者买个塑料凳子吧，摇椅太贵了。
sentences.en: Or maybe just some plastic stools—rocking chairs are way too expensive.

sentences.zh: 省下来的钱可以买个咖啡机呢，这样朋友来了都可以用新杯子喝咖啡。
sentences.en: The money I save could go toward a coffee maker, so when friends come over, everyone can drink coffee out of the new mugs.

sentences.zh: 我要再买两个盆栽放在电视柜上。
sentences.en: I'm also gonna get a couple of potted plants to put on the TV stand.

sentences.zh: 我今天数学测验考了92分！天呐我太厉害了！
sentences.en: I got a ninety-two on my math quiz today! Oh my gosh, I'm amazing!

sentences.zh: 让我看一下我的排名。
sentences.en: Let me check where I ranked.

sentences.zh: 第一名！我居然是第一名！
sentences.en: First place! I'm actually in first place!

sentences.zh: 哦看错了，我是倒数第一。
sentences.en: Oh wait, I read that wrong—I'm in last place.

sentences.zh: 我就说嘛，150分的总分，我考了92怎么会是第一名呢。
sentences.en: I was gonna say—out of one hundred and fifty points, how could ninety-two be first?

sentences.zh: 不过我也及格了，已经很厉害了，这是我第一次及格。
sentences.en: But hey, I still passed, so that's a win—this is literally my first time passing!

sentences.zh: 而且我才努力了一个月，就进步了十分。
sentences.en: Plus, I only put in a month of work and already bumped my score up by ten points.

sentences.zh: 照这个进步速度下去，我很有可能考上清华啊
sentences.en: At this rate of progress, I might actually get into Tsinghua!

sentences.zh: 到时候我是选清华还是选北大呢？
sentences.en: So when the time comes... should I pick Tsinghua or Peking University?

sentences.zh: 无语了我这次六级居然还没过。
sentences.en: I can't even—I still didn't pass CET-6 this time.

sentences.zh: 我本来计划大一过四级，大二过六级的。
sentences.en: My original plan was to pass CET-4 freshman year and CET-6 sophomore year.

sentences.zh: 我现在都大四了，大三才把四级考出来的。
sentences.en: Now I'm already a senior, and I barely passed CET-4 in my junior year!

sentences.zh: 这是我最后一次机会了，我马上就要毕业了。
sentences.en: That was basically my last chance—I'm graduating super soon.

sentences.zh: 奥对研究生也可以接着考六级，但是我考研也没考上呀，得二战。
sentences.en: Oh wait, grad students can still take CET-6—but I didn't get into grad school, so I gotta try again next year.

sentences.zh: 那我还是先努力考研吧。
sentences.en: Guess I'd better focus on getting into grad school first.

sentences.zh: 你说等我研究生毕业我是接着考博还是工作呢？
sentences.en: What do you think—once I finish my master's, should I go for a PhD or just get a job?

sentences.zh: 或者我现在就直接工作呢？
sentences.en: Or maybe I should just start working now?

sentences.zh: 我再好好考虑考虑吧。
sentences.en: Let me give it some real thought.

sentences.zh: 今天地理老师骂我了
sentences.en: My geography teacher chewed me out today.

sentences.zh: 他说我考个十分还好意思上课说话。
sentences.en: He said I got a ten and still had the nerve to talk in class.

sentences.zh: 真的很生气，我是13分！不是10分！
sentences.en: I was so mad—I got a thirteen! Not a ten!

sentences.zh: 我好不容易考个两位数，他还给我省掉3分。
sentences.en: It took a miracle for me to hit double digits, and he took away three points!

sentences.zh: 真的很不喜欢地理，要是每天都上音乐课和美术课就好了。
sentences.en: I really hate geography—I wish every day was just music and art classes.

sentences.zh: 其实数学物理化学这些我也都挺喜欢的，就是不喜欢地理。
sentences.en: Honestly, I actually like math, physics, and chemistry—it's literally just geography I can't stand.

sentences.zh: 讨厌地理也讨厌地理老师，地理老师也讨厌我。
sentences.en: I hate geography, I hate the teacher, and the feeling is completely mutual.

sentences.zh: 我也可能是旅游的太少了，应该让我爸妈多带出去玩玩。
sentences.en: Or maybe I just haven't traveled enough—my parents definitely need to take me on more trips!

sentences.zh: 我的笔记本找不到了，我记了好多笔记呢。
sentences.en: I can't find my notebook—I had so many notes in it!

sentences.zh: 奇怪，我就放在书包里的呀，怎么会不见了呢？
sentences.en: Weird, I swear I put it in my backpack—how could it just disappear?

sentences.zh: 哦我好像是落在学校的储物柜里了。
sentences.en: Oh wait, I think I left it in my locker at school.

sentences.zh: 我现在回学校拿，我要用这个笔记本复习呢，我们下周要考试。
sentences.en: I'm heading back to school to grab it—I need it to study since we have exams next week.

sentences.zh: 我到学校了，周末只有门卫大爷在。
sentences.en: I'm at school now—since it's the weekend, only the security guard is here.

sentences.zh: 怎么办，我们班教室的门锁上了，我的笔记本在里面的。
sentences.en: Oh no, what do I do? Our classroom is locked, and my notebook is inside!

sentences.zh: 大爷刚才帮我把门打开啦，我拿到笔记本了。
sentences.en: The security guard just unlocked the door for me, so I got my notebook!

sentences.zh: 我把我的彩铅和橡皮也拿回来了。
sentences.en: I grabbed my colored pencils and eraser while I was at it, too.

sentences.zh: 今天是我入职第一天，好兴奋哦。
sentences.en: It's my first day at work today—I'm so excited!

sentences.zh: 公司给配的这个电脑好好啊，键盘鼠标都是那种一看就很贵的。
sentences.en: My company computer is so nice—the keyboard and mouse look super high-end!

sentences.zh: 公司还有免费的咖啡和零食柜。
sentences.en: They even have free coffee and a fully stocked snack bar.

sentences.zh: 我听同事说每天下午还会发下午茶，是一个冰淇淋。
sentences.en: My coworkers said we get afternoon treats every day, like ice cream!

sentences.zh: 公司环境也很好，不是那种小格子间。
sentences.en: The office setup is great, too—it's not made up of cramped little cubicles.

sentences.zh: 我去厕所看看厕所环境怎么样。
sentences.en: I'm gonna go check out the bathroom to see how it is.

sentences.zh: 哇厕所也很干净耶，有马桶也有蹲坑。
sentences.en: Wow, the bathroom is super clean, too—they have both western toilets and squat toilets.

sentences.zh: 我一定要通过试用期！成为一个正式员工。
sentences.en: I'm definitely gonna pass my probation and become a permanent employee!

sentences.zh: 刚才我们领导过来通知我们这个周末又要加班。
sentences.en: Our manager just came by to tell us we have to work overtime again this weekend.

sentences.zh: 气死我了，加班从来不给加班费。
sentences.en: I'm so pissed—we never get paid overtime.

sentences.zh: 他说下周工作日可以选一天休息，可是我是加班了两天呀。
sentences.en: He said we can take a weekday off next week, but I'm working two whole extra days!

sentences.zh: 万恶的资本家！
sentences.en: Damn capitalists!

sentences.zh: 真是不想打工了，好想创业，但是我又没那个脑子。
sentences.en: I really don't wanna work for someone else anymore. I wanna start my own business, but I just don't have the brains for it.

sentences.zh: 我要去招聘网站看看有没有什么新工作。
sentences.en: I'm gonna check job boards to see if there's anything good out there.

sentences.zh: 等我找到新工作再辞职，我现在不能没有这份工作。
sentences.en: I'll quit once I find a new job—I can't afford to be out of work right now.

sentences.zh: 我还有房贷车贷要还呢。
sentences.en: I still have a mortgage and a car payment to make.

sentences.zh: 我在网上买了一条白色的裙子，好显胖。
sentences.en: I bought a white dress online, but it's so unflattering—it makes me look so big!

sentences.zh: 我其实最喜欢粉色，但是这个裙子没有粉色的，只有白色黑色蓝色黄色绿色。
sentences.en: Pink is actually my favorite, but this dress doesn't come in pink—only white, black, blue, yellow, and green.

sentences.zh: 要不我还是买黑色的吧，黑色最百搭。
sentences.en: Maybe I should just get black—black is the most versatile color.

sentences.zh: 啊哦，黑色没有M码了，S我穿不上，L和XL又太大了。
sentences.en: Oh wait, black is sold out in medium. Small won't fit me, and large and XL are way too big.

sentences.zh: 算了，那我不买了，不过这个裙子的款式我真的好喜欢。
sentences.en: Never mind then, I won't get it—though I really love the style.

sentences.zh: 要不我买个黑色的L码，再配个粉色的腰带？
sentences.en: How about I get the black in large and style it with a pink belt?

sentences.zh: 嗯，我先把白色的这个退了，还好买了运费险。
sentences.en: Yeah, I'll return the white one first. Good thing I got the return shipping coverage!

sentences.zh: 等我的黑裙子和粉色腰带到了，我穿上拍照片给你看。
sentences.en: Once my black dress and pink belt get here, I'll try them on and send you a photo!

sentences.zh: 我老收不到验证码是怎么回事？
sentences.en: Why do I never get the verification codes?

sentences.zh: 我在登录一个网站嘛，发了好几次验证码了都收不到。
sentences.en: I'm trying to log into a website—I've requested the code multiple times and still nothing.

sentences.zh: 手机的垃圾信息我也看了，也没有啊
sentences.en: I even checked my spam texts—nothing there either!

sentences.zh: 奥是我手机号输错了。
sentences.en: Oh wait, I typed in the wrong phone number.

sentences.zh: 真服了怎么输完验证码还要输密码，我根本不记得密码呀。
sentences.en: Seriously?! Why does it ask for my password after I just entered the code? I don't even remember my password!

sentences.zh: 我点忘记密码，它让我重设，我重设了，它说新密码不能和原密码一样。。。
sentences.en: I clicked "forgot password?" to reset it, and after I entered a new one, it told me the new password can't be the same as the old one...

sentences.zh: 终于登上了。。。我要把密码保存一下，不然下次又忘了。
sentences.en: Finally made it in! I'm definitely saving this password so I don't forget it again.

sentences.zh: 我朋友Emma刚才吐槽我老是不回她消息。
sentences.en: My friend Emma just called me out for taking forever to text back.

sentences.zh: 其实我不是故意的，我以为我回了，但其实没有。
sentences.en: It's not even intentional—I genuinely thought I replied, but I actually didn't!

sentences.zh: 有时候她给我发的链接嘛，我点进去看完就忘记回她了。
sentences.en: Sometimes when she sends me links, I'll click on them, browse for a bit, and totally forget to respond.

sentences.zh: 我刚才跟她视频了好久终于把她哄好了。
sentences.en: I was just on a video call with her for the longest time and finally smoothed things over.

sentences.zh: 她特别好，每次我给她发消息她都是秒回。
sentences.en: She's so sweet—whenever I text her, she replies instantly.

sentences.zh: 她连洗澡的时候都会回我的消息。
sentences.en: She'll even text me back from the shower!

sentences.zh: 这么一看我真是太过分了，周末请她吃个大餐。
sentences.en: Man, I really am the worst. I'm definitely taking her out for a big meal this weekend!

sentences.zh: 以后我一定要及时回她消息。
sentences.en: From now on, I'm gonna be way better at replying right away.

sentences.zh: 我们一会儿要去KTV哦。
sentences.en: We're heading to karaoke later!

sentences.zh: 我已经好久没有去过KTV了，感觉现在大家都不太去了。
sentences.en: I haven't been to karaoke in forever—feels like nobody really goes anymore.

sentences.zh: 哇老板给我们升级成大包了耶，我们本来订的中包。
sentences.en: Wow, the manager upgraded us to a large room! We originally booked a medium one.

sentences.zh: 这家KTV的麦克风和音响都挺好的呢。
sentences.en: The mics and sound system here are actually really good.

sentences.zh: 刚才服务员来给我们送了爆米花和果盘，这也太划算了吧。
sentences.en: The server just brought us free popcorn and a fruit platter—what a steal!

sentences.zh: 我们订的这个是3个小时49.8
sentences.en: We booked three hours for just like forty-nine point eight kuai.

sentences.zh: 不过这家KTV好多歌都没有MV。
sentences.en: But a lot of the songs here don't have music videos.

sentences.zh: 我朋友说是因为没有买MV的版权。
sentences.en: My friend said it's because they didn't license the videos.

sentences.zh: 怪不得这么便宜呢。
sentences.en: Ah, no wonder it's so cheap!

sentences.zh: 我们今天晚上去看了个电影，可好看了。
sentences.en: We went to see a movie tonight—it was so good!

sentences.zh: 是贾玲主演的，我超级喜欢她，她也是导演。
sentences.en: It stars Jia Ling—I absolutely love her, and she directed it too!

sentences.zh: 看电影的人超级多，还好我们昨天就买票了。
sentences.en: The theater was super packed—good thing we got our tickets yesterday.

sentences.zh: 不过我们这次位置不太好，在第三排，离屏幕太近了。
sentences.en: Our seats weren't great, though—third row, way too close to the screen.

sentences.zh: 我们平常看电影都是坐倒数第三排，这次买票的时候只有前三排有位置了。
sentences.en: We usually sit three rows from the back, but only the front three rows were left when we booked.

sentences.zh: 而且看电影的时候后面的人老是踢我座位，还有个人老是剧透。
sentences.en: Plus, the guy behind me kept kicking my seat, and someone else was dropping spoilers the whole time!

sentences.zh: 真的特别讨厌剧透的人。
sentences.en: I seriously hate people who spoil movies.

sentences.zh: 这个电影真的太好看了，周一我要去二刷。
sentences.en: This movie was just so good—I'm definitely gonna watch it again on Monday.

sentences.zh: 好开心呀，我们下午要去海边玩哦。
sentences.en: I'm so hyped—we're hitting the beach this afternoon!

sentences.zh: 我买了个特别好看的比基尼还有墨镜，我要去晒日光浴。
sentences.en: I bought a super cute bikini and sunglasses, and I'm totally going sunbathing!

sentences.zh: 我们到沙滩啦，今天天气好好啊，海特别蓝。
sentences.en: We made it to the beach! The weather is unreal today, and the ocean is so blue.

sentences.zh: 我买了个椰子才10块钱。
sentences.en: I grabbed a coconut for only ten yuan!

sentences.zh: 好想潜水呀，但是我今天涂了很多防晒霜。
sentences.en: I really wanna go diving, but I slathered on so much sunscreen today.

sentences.zh: 还是改天再潜水吧，因为我也根本不会潜水。
sentences.en: Maybe I'll save it for another day... especially since I don't even know how to dive anyway!

sentences.zh: 哇好多海鸥啊，我要去买点吃的喂海鸥。
sentences.en: Whoa, look at all these seagulls! I'm gonna get some food to feed them.

sentences.zh: 海鸥刚才飞到我手上了！太可爱了！
sentences.en: A seagull literally just landed on my hand! That was so cute!

sentences.zh: 我今天办了一张健身房的年卡。
sentences.en: I got an annual gym membership today!

sentences.zh: 这个健身房还挺好的，还有泳池呢。
sentences.en: This gym is pretty sweet—it even has a pool!

sentences.zh: 办了年卡就可以随时来游泳，泳池也挺干净的。
sentences.en: With the membership, I can come swim whenever I want, and the pool's actually really clean.

sentences.zh: 不过我得买泳衣泳帽泳镜。
sentences.en: But I gotta get a swimsuit, a swim cap, and some goggles first.

sentences.zh: 奥这个健身房每天下午6点半还有团课呢，可以跟着一起跳操。
sentences.en: Oh, and they have group fitness classes every day at six thirty PM—I can join in.

sentences.zh: 我买的这个年卡是1800，你觉得贵不贵？
sentences.en: I paid eighteen hundred for the whole year—do you think that's steep?

sentences.zh: 明天我就打算先来做做无氧。
sentences.en: Tomorrow I'm planning to hit the weights first.

sentences.zh: 我不太喜欢有氧，因为我想长肌肉，做有氧不长肌肉。
sentences.en: I'm not really into cardio because I wanna build muscle, and cardio doesn't really help with that.

sentences.zh: 我们今天晚上要去看周杰伦的演唱会！
sentences.en: We're going to Jay Chou's concert tonight!

sentences.zh: 而且我们这次居然买到了内场票！
sentences.en: And we actually scored floor tickets this time!

sentences.zh: 太幸福了！这还是我第一次坐内场，以前看演唱会都买的看台票。
sentences.en: I'm so hyped! This is my first time getting floor seats—.I always got seats in the upper sections before.

sentences.zh: 我们的位置在第三排离舞台超级近！
sentences.en: We're in row three—way close to the stage!

sentences.zh: 但是我们这个座位有点靠左，到时候他应该主要是在舞台中间。
sentences.en: Our seats are a bit off to the left, though, and he'll probably stay center stage most of the time.

sentences.zh: 不过也可以看清脸，我已经很满足了。
sentences.en: Still, I can see his face super clearly—I'm honestly thrilled!

sentences.zh: 啊啊啊啊啊周杰伦要出场了！
sentences.en: Ahhhhh Jay Chou is about to come out!

sentences.zh: 啊啊啊啊啊他刚才到左边来了！
sentences.en: Ahhhhh he just walked over to our side!

sentences.zh: 结束了，我嗓子都喊哑了。
sentences.en: It's over—I lost my voice from screaming so much!

sentences.zh: 我刚才切土豆把手指头切到了。
sentences.en: I just cut my finger while chopping potatoes.

sentences.zh: 流了好多血，可疼了。
sentences.en: It bled a ton—it hurts like hell!

sentences.zh: 还好伤口不算很深，我涂了点碘伏，贴了个创口贴。
sentences.en: Luckily the cut wasn't too deep—I put some antiseptic on it and put a Band-Aid over it.

sentences.zh: 现在不流血了。
sentences.en: It's stopped bleeding now.

sentences.zh: 不过我指甲也切到了，本来还想今天下午去做美甲呢。
sentences.en: But I also nicked my nail—and I was actually planning to get a manicure this afternoon.

sentences.zh: 这几天我洗脸都只能用右手了。
sentences.en: I'll have to wash my face with just my right hand for the next few days.

sentences.zh: 洗澡也得很小心，这个手指头不能沾水。
sentences.en: I gotta be super careful when showering too—can't get this finger wet at all.

sentences.zh: 以后我切菜一定要小心点。
sentences.en: I really need to be more careful when chopping veggies from now on.

sentences.zh: 好像网上有卖那种防切手手套的，我去买一个。
sentences.en: I think they sell those cut-resistant gloves online—I'm gonna go order one.

sentences.zh: 我想下周出去玩，但还没想好去哪。
sentences.en: I wanna go on a trip next week, but I haven't decided where to go yet.

sentences.zh: 我想出国玩，韩国日本新加坡泰国这些都挺想去的。
sentences.en: I wanna travel abroad—South Korea, Japan, Singapore, Thailand—they all sound awesome!

sentences.zh: 其实美国英国法国德国这些也很想去，但是签证不太好办。
sentences.en: Honestly, I'd love to visit the US, UK, France, or Germany, but getting a visa is such a hassle.

sentences.zh: 要不我就去济州岛或者泰国吧，都是免签的。
sentences.en: Maybe I'll just go to Jeju Island or Thailand—I don't need a visa for either of them.

sentences.zh: 我一个朋友可厉害了，她自己一个人去了澳大利亚和加拿大新西兰。
sentences.en: One of my friends is incredible—she traveled solo to Australia, Canada, and New Zealand!

sentences.zh: 她胆子特别大，她还自己去过南非呢，去看了好多野生动物。
sentences.en: She's totally fearless—she even went to South Africa by herself to see all the wildlife!

sentences.zh: 我也挺想去南非的，但是下周朋友们都有事，我自己不敢去。
sentences.en: I'd love to go to South Africa too, but my friends are all busy next week and I'm too chicken to go alone.

sentences.zh: 我还是去济州岛吧，就这么愉快的决定了。
sentences.en: I think I'll stick with Jeju Island. Decision made!

sentences.zh: 我到酒店啦，这个酒店好棒啊。
sentences.en: I'm at the hotel—this place is incredible!

sentences.zh: 我们这个房间视野特别好，因为楼层很高。
sentences.en: Our room has an amazing view because we're on a high floor.

sentences.zh: 而且房间也很干净，是全屋智能。
sentences.en: And it's super clean—the whole room is smart, too.

sentences.zh: 还提供了好多个一次性马桶垫呢。
sentences.en: They even provided a bunch of disposable toilet seat covers.

sentences.zh: 哇这个房间有投影仪和一个超级大的幕布耶，晚上可以窝在床上看电影了。
sentences.en: Wow, this room has a projector and a massive screen—we can curl up in bed and watch movies tonight!

sentences.zh: 天呐居然还有一个小冰箱
sentences.en: Oh my god, there's even a mini fridge!

sentences.zh: 我订这个酒店的时候就是看它评分特别高，怪不得呢。
sentences.en: I booked this place because it was so highly rated—now I totally get why!

sentences.zh: 这个一次性拖鞋也是我住过的酒店里最好的，甚至看着都不像一次性的。
sentences.en: These disposable slippers are the best I've ever had at a hotel—they don't even look disposable!

sentences.zh: 我们来北京旅游啦，打算明天去故宫玩玩。
sentences.en: We're on a trip in Beijing—planning to visit the Forbidden City tomorrow!

sentences.zh: 哎呀我还没买门票呢，赶紧买票。
sentences.en: Oh shoot, I haven't bought tickets yet—gotta get on that right now.

sentences.zh: 天呐居然没有票了！这个票居然要提前预约！我都不知道。
sentences.en: Oh my god, it's completely sold out! I had no idea you had to book in advance!

sentences.zh: 我们可是专门来看故宫的。
sentences.en: We came all the way here specifically to see the Forbidden City!

sentences.zh: 好伤心，后天大后天也都没有票了。我们只能在北京待三天。
sentences.en: I'm so bummed—it's fully booked for the next few days too, and we're only in Beijing for three days!

sentences.zh: 要是有人退票就好了。
sentences.en: If only someone would cancel and free up some tickets.

sentences.zh: 算了，我们明天去逛逛圆明园和鸟巢吧。
sentences.en: Oh well—guess we'll just check out the Old Summer Palace and the Bird's Nest tomorrow instead.

sentences.zh: 现在先出去吃个北京烤鸭。
sentences.en: For now, let's head out and grab some Peking duck!

sentences.zh: 我现在在火车站的候车室里，你猜我要去哪里？
sentences.en: I'm in the waiting hall at the train station—guess where I'm headed?

sentences.zh: 我要去拉萨，而且是坐绿皮火车哦！好兴奋！
sentences.en: I'm off to Lhasa, and I'm taking one of those old-school green trains! I'm so stoked!

sentences.zh: 要检票啦，我去排队了。
sentences.en: Ticket check is starting—I'm gonna head over to the queue!

sentences.zh: 我上车了，好久没坐过绿皮火车了，好激动。
sentences.en: Just got on the train! It's been forever since I took a green train—I'm so hyped!

sentences.zh: 我这次还买的硬座呢，因为我买票的时候硬卧和软卧都没有了。
sentences.en: I actually got a hard seat ticket this time because both hard and soft sleepers were completely sold out.

sentences.zh: 硬座也没关系，硬座热闹，而且我的座位靠窗呢。
sentences.en: But hard seat is fine by me—it's way more lively, plus I lucked out with a window seat!

sentences.zh: 哇路上的风景真是太美了。
sentences.en: Wow, the views along the way are absolutely breathtaking!

sentences.zh: 有点饿了，我去餐车看看有没有好吃的。
sentences.en: I'm getting a little hungry—gonna hit up the dining car and see what's good!

sentences.zh: 气死我了，刚才跟我一个室友吵了一架。
sentences.en: I'm so pissed off—I just got into a huge fight with one of my roommates.

sentences.zh: 她老是把垃圾放我桌子上，今天又把一张用过的纸放我桌子上。
sentences.en: She keeps leaving trash on my desk! Today, she put another used tissue right on my desk.

sentences.zh: 我跟她说你别把垃圾放我桌子上，她说我是不小心的。
sentences.en: I told her to stop leaving her trash on my desk, and she was like, "Oh, it was an accident."

sentences.zh: 一次两次是不小心，这都至少八九次了还是不小心吗？
sentences.en: Once or twice is an accident, but this is at least the eighth or ninth time! How is that still an accident?

sentences.zh: 而且她有一次甚至把穿过的袜子放在我桌子上。
sentences.en: One time, she even put her dirty socks on my desk.

sentences.zh: 我都不知道这到底是不是在霸凌我，她对我一直都很不好。
