sentences.en: I don't even know if she's bullying me at this point—she's always been so mean to me.

sentences.zh: 我要告诉我爸妈和老师。
sentences.en: I'm gonna tell my parents and my advisor.

sentences.zh: 真的受不了了，都不想住在这个宿舍了。
sentences.en: I seriously can't stand this anymore—I don't even wanna live in this dorm.

sentences.zh: 天呐给你讲一个超级大八卦！
sentences.en: Oh my god, I've got some big gossip!

sentences.zh: 我刚才在电影院看到我们公司的Amy和Tom了，你猜他俩在干嘛？
sentences.en: I just ran into Amy and Tom from work at the movies—guess what they were doing?

sentences.zh: 他俩居然搂在一起，Tom还喂Amy吃爆米花！他们绝对是情侣！
sentences.en: They were literally cuddling, and Tom was feeding her popcorn! They're a hundred percent dating!

sentences.zh: 太不可思议了，他俩在公司几乎都不说话的。
sentences.en: That's so crazy—they barely even talk at the office.

sentences.zh: 我从来没有想过他俩居然会在一起。
sentences.en: I would've never guessed they'd end up together.

sentences.zh: 我们公司没有禁止办公室恋爱呀，他俩为什么不告诉大家呢?
sentences.en: Our company doesn't even have a rule against office romance—why are they keeping it a secret?

sentences.zh: 反正我就跟你说说，我是不会告诉别的同事的，人家不想让大家知道肯定有人家的原因。
sentences.en: Anyway, I'm only telling you—I won't tell anyone else at work. They must have their reasons for keeping it low-key.

sentences.zh: 我已经买好下周去济州岛的机票啦。
sentences.en: I already booked my flight to Jeju Island for next week!

sentences.zh: 我刚才在手机上定了一个民宿。
sentences.en: I actually just booked an Airbnb on my phone.

sentences.zh: 这个民宿可棒了，还有一个大院子，是在一个村里。
sentences.en: This place looks amazing—it even has a big yard, and it's located in a little village.

sentences.zh: 这个村子也很方便，离市区挺近的，村子里也有公交车站。
sentences.en: The village is super convenient too—it's close to downtown and has a bus stop right there.

sentences.zh: 本来我是想定酒店的，但是我看好多攻略都说住民宿更好。
sentences.en: I was gonna book a hotel, but I read a bunch of travel blogs that recommended staying at an Airbnb.

sentences.zh: 我现在要开始准备收拾行李了。
sentences.en: Now I need to get cracking on packing my bags!

sentences.zh: 我去玩5天我要带5套衣服，每天都要出片。
sentences.en: I'm going for five days, so I'm bringing five outfits—I gotta look photo-ready every single day!

sentences.zh: 哎呀我要先买个行李箱，我这个行李箱太小了。
sentences.en: Oh shoot, I gotta buy a new suitcase first—mine is way too small.

sentences.zh: 我哥哥今天终于找到工作了。
sentences.en: My brother finally landed a job today.

sentences.zh: 他之前失业了半年，每天都在投简历。
sentences.en: He'd been unemployed for six months, just sending out resumes every single day.

sentences.zh: 今天终于收到一家公司的录用通知了。
sentences.en: And today he finally got a job offer.

sentences.zh: 他现在是个副经理，虽然工资没有以前高，但是他还是特别开心。
sentences.en: He's an assistant manager now. The pay's not as good as his old job, but he's still super happy.

sentences.zh: 我爸妈也终于放心了。
sentences.en: My parents are finally relieved too.

sentences.zh: 晚上我们准备出去吃饭庆祝一下。
sentences.en: We're gonna go out for dinner tonight to celebrate.

sentences.zh: 我哥哥还说发了第一个月的工资要给我买个新手机。
sentences.en: My brother even said he'll buy me a new phone with his first paycheck.

sentences.zh: 太开心了我要有新手机了！
sentences.en: I'm so stoked—I'm getting a new phone!

sentences.zh: 今天我小姨生孩子了，现在我们一大家子人都在医院。
sentences.en: My aunt had a baby today, and our whole family is at the hospital right now.

sentences.zh: 小宝宝是个小女孩，我终于有表妹了。
sentences.en: It's a little girl—I finally have a cousin sister!

sentences.zh: 小宝宝长得超级可爱，因为我小姨和姨夫也都长得很好看。
sentences.en: She's so cute. Her parents are both really good-looking, so it makes sense.

sentences.zh: 她的名字是我起的呢，我之前就说如果是小女孩就叫Lily，如果是小男孩就叫Eric.
sentences.en: I actually came up with her name! I said earlier if it was a girl we'd go with Lily, and if it was a boy, Eric.

sentences.zh: 现在大家都围着她叫她Lily.
sentences.en: Now everyone's gathered around her calling her Lily.

sentences.zh: 我还给她带了一个礼物呢，是一个毛绒玩具。
sentences.en: I brought her a present too—a stuffed animal.

sentences.zh: 这个毛绒玩具是一个小马，你猜我为什么送她小马。
sentences.en: It's a little pony. Wanna guess why I picked that?

sentences.zh: 因为今年是马年，Lily属马。
sentences.en: 'Cause this year's the Year of the Horse, and Lily's a little horse baby!

sentences.zh: 我今天去姑姑家玩了，好开心。
sentences.en: I went to my aunt's place today and had so much fun.

sentences.zh: 终于见到姑姑了，我好几个月都没见过她了，她是个警察，平常特别忙。
sentences.en: I finally got to see her—I hadn't seen her in months. She's a cop and she's always crazy busy.

sentences.zh: 晚饭是我姑父做的，他做饭特别好吃。
sentences.en: My uncle made dinner, and he's an amazing cook.

sentences.zh: 你猜他是做什么工作的？
sentences.en: Wanna guess what he does for a living?

sentences.zh: 他是个记者，但是他说他其实更想做厨师。
sentences.en: He's a journalist, but he says he actually wanted to be a chef.

sentences.zh: 他从小就超喜欢做饭，但是我爷爷奶奶不同意他做厨师。
sentences.en: He's loved cooking since he was a kid, but my grandparents wouldn't let him be a chef.

sentences.zh: 他今晚做了个红烧肉，天呐，是我这辈子吃过最好吃的。
sentences.en: Tonight he made braised pork belly, and oh my god—it was the best thing I've ever eaten in my life.

sentences.zh: 我一口气吃了两碗大米饭，妈呀，要是每天都在他们家吃饭我得胖死。
sentences.en: I wolfed down two big bowls of rice. God, if I ate at their place every day, I'd get so fat.

sentences.zh: 最近我掉头发有点严重。
sentences.en: I've been losing a lot of hair lately.

sentences.zh: 我每天洗头和梳头的时候，都会掉很多头发。
sentences.en: Every time I wash or brush my hair, clumps of it come out.

sentences.zh: 最近也老是头疼，可能是睡眠不足。
sentences.en: I've also been getting headaches a lot—probably from not getting enough sleep.

sentences.zh: 我这一个月都是10点以后才下班的。
sentences.en: I've been getting off work after ten PM every single night for the past month.

sentences.zh: 我真的想离职了，现在不止是掉头发和头疼，我腰也疼，手腕也疼。
sentences.en: I seriously wanna quit. It's not just the hair loss and headaches anymore—my lower back hurts, my wrists hurt too.

sentences.zh: 但是我这个工作月薪2万块呢，我又舍不得离职。
sentences.en: But I'm making twenty K a month at this job, so I can't bring myself to leave.

sentences.zh: 今天我先早点睡觉，明天醒来再考虑到底要不要离职吧。
sentences.en: I'm gonna crash early tonight and figure out whether to quit or not when I wake up tomorrow.

sentences.zh: 我好喜欢喝酒
sentences.en: I love drinking so much.

sentences.zh: 啤酒白酒红酒鸡尾酒我都很喜欢。
sentences.en: Beer, baijiu, wine, cocktails—I like all of 'em.

sentences.zh: 不过喝酒好像很伤肝脏，对肾脏也不太好
sentences.en: But I heard it's really hard on your liver, and not great for your kidneys either.

sentences.zh: 我一次可以喝10瓶啤酒。
sentences.en: I can down ten bottles of beer in one go.

sentences.zh: 他们说喝酒脸红的人不能喝酒，我不脸红。
sentences.en: They say people who get flush when they drink shouldn't drink—but I don't turn red.

sentences.zh: 不过我每次喝完酒第二天胃都不舒服。
sentences.en: But my stomach always feels awful the morning after.

sentences.zh: 以后我还是要少喝点，不能一次喝太多。
sentences.en: I should probably cut back and not drink so much in one sitting.

sentences.zh: 我一个朋友每次喝完酒心跳都特别快，他去年就戒酒了。
sentences.en: A friend of mine, his heart goes crazy every time he drinks—he quit last year.

sentences.zh: 我打算以后每周一三五都去健身。
sentences.en: I'm planning to hit the gym every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

sentences.zh: 周一练背和胸，周三练肩和手臂，周五练臀腿，你觉得怎么样？
sentences.en: Mondays for back and chest, Wednesdays for shoulders and arms, Fridays for glutes and legs—what do you think?

sentences.zh: 你觉得我需要单独练一下核心吗？
sentences.en: Do you think I need to work on my core separately?

sentences.zh: 我还想每天跑半个小时步，但是又有点怕伤膝盖。
sentences.en: I also wanna run for half an hour every day, but I'm kinda scared of messing up my knees.

sentences.zh: 我听别人说跑步会让小腿变的很粗，真的吗？
sentences.en: I heard running makes your calves super bulky—is that true?

sentences.zh: 我去年跑步把脚扭了，到现在快一年都没跑步了。
sentences.en: I sprained my ankle running last year and haven't gone running in almost a year.

sentences.zh: 我得先买双跑鞋，现在脚上这双一跑步就脚趾头疼。
sentences.en: I need to get a new pair of running shoes first—the ones I have now make my toes hurt every time I run.

sentences.zh: 等我的鞋到了我再开始健身。
sentences.en: I'll start working out once my shoes arrive.

sentences.zh: 我刚照镜子突然发现我的头发长长了好多啊。
sentences.en: I just looked in the mirror and realized my hair's gotten so long.

sentences.zh: 我感觉我应该去剪头发了。
sentences.en: I feel like I should go get a haircut.

sentences.zh: 但是我特别怕理发师给我剪的太短了
sentences.en: But I'm so scared the hairdresser will chop off way too much.

sentences.zh: 好多理发师都跟听不懂人话一样，你说剪一点点，他能给你剪15cm.
sentences.en: So many hairdressers just don't get it—you ask for a tiny trim, and they cut off five inches!

sentences.zh: 要不我自己剪算了，还省钱呢
sentences.en: Maybe I should just do it myself—save some money too.

sentences.zh: 决定了，我就自己剪，我找一下剪刀。
sentences.en: That's it, I'm doing it myself. Lemme find some scissors.

sentences.zh: 哇，我剪的还不错耶，太厉害了我，省了30块钱。
sentences.en: Wow, I actually did a pretty good job—I'm a natural, just saved myself thirty kuai.

sentences.zh: 不过现在洗漱台上全是我的碎头发，我要收拾一下。
sentences.en: But now the sink is covered in all my hair clippings—gotta clean that up.

sentences.zh: 最近我的手可干了，不知道是因为空气干燥还是什么原因。
sentences.en: My hands have been so dry lately—don't know if it's the dry air or what.

sentences.zh: 也可能是我洗手洗太多了？我一天洗十几次。
sentences.en: Maybe it's 'cause I wash my hands too much? I do it like a dozen times a day.

sentences.zh: 我买了一瓶护手霜，但是老是忘记涂。
sentences.en: I bought some hand cream but always forget to put it on.

sentences.zh: 我买的护肤水，面霜眼霜我也老是忘记涂，我脸也挺干的。
sentences.en: I also forget to use my toner, moisturizer, and eye cream—my face is super dry too.

sentences.zh: 我太懒了，每天洗完澡就想直接睡觉
sentences.en: I'm just too lazy—as soon as I get out of the shower, I just wanna crash.

sentences.zh: 真的很佩服那些每天坚持护肤的人。
sentences.en: I seriously admire people who stick to a skincare routine every day.

sentences.zh: 妈呀，突然想起来我去年买了盒超级贵的面膜都没用过。
sentences.en: Oh shoot, I just remembered I bought a super expensive box of sheet masks last year and haven't even touched them.

sentences.zh: 啊哦，刚看了一下，过期了.....
sentences.en: Oops, just checked—they're expired...

sentences.zh: 刚在路上见到一个女生超级漂亮。
sentences.en: I just saw this girl on the street who was absolutely stunning.

sentences.zh: 就是那种标准的瓜子脸大眼睛高鼻梁小嘴巴，而且皮肤也很白。
sentences.en: Like, textbook perfect—oval face, big eyes, high nose bridge, small lips, and really fair skin.

sentences.zh: 而且她头发又黑又亮又长，差不多到腰吧。
sentences.en: Her hair was so long, black, and shiny—almost down to her waist.

sentences.zh: 她个子也很高，至少有一米72，腿可长了。
sentences.en: She was tall too—at least 5'7"(five seven)—with super long legs.

sentences.zh: 而且她穿的就是那种很普通的牛仔裤和T恤，居然都很好看。
sentences.en: And she was just wearing regular jeans and a T-shirt, but she still looked amazing.

sentences.zh: 果然好看的人穿什么都好看。
sentences.en: Good-looking people really do look good in anything.

sentences.zh: 好喜欢在路上看到帅哥美女，特别养眼。
sentences.en: I love seeing attractive people on the street—it's such a treat for the eyes!

sentences.zh: 今天真是幸运的一天呢，早上一出门就见到大美女。
sentences.en: What a lucky day—stepped out this morning and immediately spotted a total stunner!

sentences.zh: 明天我要在公司年会上表演节目哦
sentences.en: I'm performing at our company’s annual party tomorrow!

sentences.zh: 我和一个男同事合唱，他穿黑色西装，我在想我穿什么呢
sentences.en: I'm doing a duet with a male coworker—he's wearing a black suit, and I'm trying to figure out what to wear.

sentences.zh: 我打算穿个黑色的连衣裙，配一双银色的高跟鞋，你觉得怎么样？
sentences.en: I'm thinking a black dress with silver heels—what do you think?

sentences.zh: 我这个高跟鞋可好看了，上面有好多钻石，虽然是假的。
sentences.en: These heels are gorgeous—they've got tons of rhinestones on them, even if they're not real diamonds.

sentences.zh: 我还要带上我的项链和手链。
sentences.en: I'm also gonna wear my necklace and bracelet.

sentences.zh: 哦对了，我还要把头发烫卷，带上耳环。
sentences.en: Oh right, I'm gonna curl my hair and put on some earrings too.

sentences.zh: 哦还有戒指！我的手也要美美的，晚上我还要去美个甲。
sentences.en: Oh, and rings! Gotta make my hands pretty too—I'm getting my nails done tonight.

sentences.zh: 不跟你说了，我们一会儿还要去彩排呢。
sentences.en: Gotta go—we have rehearsal in a bit!

sentences.zh: 刚才打了个车，但是一直找不到司机，我就取消了。
sentences.en: I just I just got an Uber but couldn't find the driver, so I cancelled it.

sentences.zh: 那个司机一直跟我说让我往东走，但是我压根不知道东在哪。
sentences.en: The driver kept telling me to head east, but I have no clue where east is.

sentences.zh: 啊突然想到我刚才可以用手机里的指南针耶。
sentences.en: Oh wait, I just realized I could've used the compass on my phone.

sentences.zh: 我自己完全分不清东南西北，除非在学校里。
sentences.en: I literally cannot tell north from south from east from west—unless I'm on campus.

sentences.zh: 学校有东门西门南门北门所以我可以分清。
sentences.en: 'Cause my campus has an East Gate, West Gate, South Gate, and North Gate, so I can figure it out.

sentences.zh: 出了学校我方向感就很差了，尤其是在这种陌生城市。
sentences.en: Once I leave campus, my sense of direction is terrible—especially in a city I don't know.

sentences.zh: 真的不懂那种到哪都能分清东南西北的人到底是怎么做到的。
sentences.en: I honestly don't get how some people always know which way they're facing!

sentences.zh: 我又重新打了个车，现在在车上啦。
sentences.en: I just got another Uber—I'm in the car now.

sentences.zh: 明天是我爸妈结婚30周年纪念日，我还没想好送他们什么呢。
sentences.en: Tomorrow's my parents' 30th(thirtieth) wedding anniversary, and I still haven't figured out what to get them.

sentences.zh: 你说我送个相册怎么样？我今年给他们拍了很多照片。
sentences.en: What do you think about a photo album? I've taken so many pictures of them this year.

sentences.zh: 或者我送他们一次旅行？
sentences.en: Or maybe I should send them on a trip?

sentences.zh: 他们结婚的时候没有办婚礼也没有度蜜月。
sentences.en: They never had a wedding or went on a honeymoon when they got married.

sentences.zh: 哦不用我了，刚才我爸妈跟我说他们明天要去马尔代夫玩，已经订好票了。
sentences.en: Oh wait, never mind—my parents just told me they're going to the Maldives tomorrow and already booked the tickets.

sentences.zh: 没想到他们俩加起来都100岁了，还挺浪漫。
sentences.en: Didn't expect them to be so romantic——they're one hundred years old put together.

sentences.zh: 那我还是送相册吧，我今天就去把手机里的照片都打印出来。
sentences.en: I'll stick with the photo album then—I'm gonna go print out all the photos from my phone today.

sentences.zh: 他们明天上午10点出发，我要在10点之前把相册做好。
sentences.en: They're leaving at ten AM tomorrow, so I need to have the album ready before then.

sentences.zh: 今天我去参加邻居爷爷的葬礼了。
sentences.en: Today I went to the funeral of the sweet old man who lived next door.

sentences.zh: 这个爷爷平时看着可健康了，没想到才75岁就去世了。
sentences.en: He always seemed so healthy—I can't believe he passed away at just seventy-five.

sentences.zh: 我妈妈说是因为天上的神仙想要跟爷爷下棋，所以就让他去天上了。
sentences.en: My mom said fairies in heaven needed a chess partner, so they took him there.

sentences.zh: 爷爷可爱下棋了，整个小区都没有人能赢他。
sentences.en: Grandpa loved chess—nobody in the whole neighborhood could beat him.

sentences.zh: 他还教过我下棋呢，但是我没有学会。
sentences.en: He even tried to teach me once, but I never got the hang of it.

sentences.zh: 我小时候这个爷爷还经常给我买冰淇淋.
sentences.en: When I was little, he used to buy me ice cream all the time.

sentences.zh: 每年过年的时候我都会去邻居爷爷家拜年。
sentences.en: I'd visit him every Chinese New Year and give him my New Year wishes.

sentences.zh: 如果有来世，希望他做一个很幸福的人。
sentences.en: If there's an afterlife, I hope he's happy there.

sentences.zh: 我今天晚饭做了一个土豆炒蘑菇可好吃了。
sentences.en: I made stir-fried potatoes with mushrooms for dinner tonight—it was so good.

sentences.zh: 我也是在网上学的，只放了一点点油，盐，酱油，胡椒粉。
sentences.en: I learned it online too—just used a little oil, salt, soy sauce, and pepper.

sentences.zh: 奥对了还放了很多蒜，蒜是最重要的。
sentences.en: Oh right, and lots of garlic—garlic is the key.

sentences.zh: 我还自己烤了一片面包和两个鸡翅，也很好吃。
sentences.en: I also toasted a slice of bread and baked two chicken wings—they were delicious too.

sentences.zh: 我打算现在洗点水果吃。
sentences.en: I'm gonna wash some fruit now.

sentences.zh: 家里有菠萝芒果和荔枝。
sentences.en: We've got pineapple, mango, and lychee at home.

sentences.zh: 哇这个菠萝好甜啊。
sentences.en: Wow, this pineapple is so sweet.

sentences.zh: 太幸福了！可惜你吃不上我的水果。
sentences.en: Life is good! Too bad you can't try any of my fruit.

sentences.zh: 好饿呀，我点了三个外卖，饺子，烧烤，还有奶茶，怎么还不到！
sentences.en: I'm so hungry—I ordered takeout from three different places: dumplings, BBQ, and bubble tea. Why aren't they here yet?!

sentences.zh: 哦到了。
sentences.en: Oh, they're here.

sentences.zh: 本来想的今天开始减肥呢，算了，还是明天开始吧
sentences.en: I was gonna start my diet today, but eh, I'll start tomorrow instead.

sentences.zh: 这个饺子味道不错耶，就是忘记给我送醋了，要是有醋就更好了
sentences.en: These dumplings are pretty good—but they forgot to send vinegar. Would've been even better with some vinegar.

sentences.zh: 我最喜欢吃韭菜猪肉馅的饺子了
sentences.en: My favorite dumpling filling is garlic chive and pork.

sentences.zh: 白菜的其实也不错，不过韭菜猪肉最好吃
sentences.en: Cabbage is actually pretty good too, but garlic chive and pork is the best.

sentences.zh: 韭菜虾仁的也好吃，韭菜真是太适合用来包饺子了
sentences.en: Garlic chive and shrimp dumplings are great too—garlic chives are just perfect for dumplings.

sentences.zh: 这个羊肉串味道也不错呢。
sentences.en: These lamb skewers are pretty tasty too.

sentences.zh: 啊，吃完饺子和烧烤再喝奶茶真是太幸福了
sentences.en: Ahh, having dumplings and BBQ followed by bubble tea—pure bliss!

sentences.zh: 为什么我切的土豆丝一点都不均匀呢？粗的粗细的细的。
sentences.en: Why are my shredded potatoes so uneven? Some are thick, some are thin.

sentences.zh: 应该是刀和案板不行，我明天去买个新刀和新案板。
sentences.en: It must be the knife and cutting board—I'm gonna buy new ones tomorrow.

sentences.zh: 虽然土豆丝不均匀，但是炒出来说不定很好吃呢，我特别会炒菜。
sentences.en: Even if they're uneven, maybe they'll still taste great—I'm actually really good at stir-fry dishes.

sentences.zh: 哇好难吃啊！这辈子没吃过这么难吃的菜。
sentences.en: Wow, this is awful! I've never had anything this bad in my life.

sentences.zh: 应该是锅和铲子不行，我明天去买个新锅和新铲子。
sentences.en: It must be the wok and spatula—I'm getting new ones tomorrow.

sentences.zh: 不过我这个摆盘还是很好看的，因为这个盘子超好看。
sentences.en: But my plating still looks great—'cause the plate itself is gorgeous.

sentences.zh: 盘子是我上周在商场买的，花了80块呢。
sentences.en: Bought it at the mall last week for eighty yuan.

sentences.zh: 空气炸锅真是全世界最伟大的发明！
sentences.en: The air fryer is literally the greatest invention ever!

sentences.zh: 我刚才用空气炸锅烤了一片面包吃，天呐太好吃了！
sentences.en: I just made a slice of toast in the air fryer—oh my god, it was so good!

sentences.zh: 而且我什么都没放，就涂了一点黄油。
sentences.en: And I didn't even add anything—just a little butter.

sentences.zh: 我以前都是用微波炉烤面包的，味道就一般般。
sentences.en: I used to heat up bread in the microwave, and it was just meh.

sentences.zh: 天呐，配上果酱吃更好吃了！
sentences.en: Oh my god, with some jam on top—even better!

sentences.zh: 我要再用空气炸锅烤点莲花白。
sentences.en: I'm gonna air-fry some cabbage next.

sentences.zh: 我在网上找了个教程，我要跟着教程做。
sentences.en: I found a recipe online and I'm gonna follow it.

sentences.zh: 哇！！太好吃了！空气炸锅怎么做什么都这么好吃！
sentences.en: Wow!! So good! How does the air fryer make everything taste so good?!

sentences.zh: 好讨厌洗碗啊！
sentences.en: I hate doing the dishes so much!

sentences.zh: 我要是有个洗碗机就好了，但是没钱买。
sentences.en: I wish I had a dishwasher, but I can't afford one.

sentences.zh: 我家这个电饭锅可难刷了，而且我今天吃了好几个菜，要洗好几个盘子和碗。
sentences.en: This rice cooker of mine is a pain to clean, and I had several dishes today—so many plates and bowls to wash.

sentences.zh: 我觉得筷子也不好洗，勺子和叉子还行。
sentences.en: Chopsticks are annoying to wash too—spoons and forks are fine though.

sentences.zh: 你知道最难洗的是什么吗？
sentences.en: Wanna know the hardest thing to wash?

sentences.zh: 削皮刀！我每次都要洗好久。
sentences.en: The peeler! I have to scrub that thing forever every time.

sentences.zh: 而且洗碗看起来只是洗碗，实际上还要洗案板，刀，抹布，还要收拾厨房。
sentences.en: And washing dishes isn't just dishes—you also have to wash the cutting board, knives, the rag, and clean up the whole kitchen.

sentences.zh: 每次做饭半小时，洗碗至少要一个小时。
sentences.en: Cooking takes half an hour, but doing the dishes takes at least an hour.

sentences.zh: 我要存钱买洗碗机！
sentences.en: I'm gonna save up for a dishwasher!

sentences.zh: 今天晚上我们要去一家素食餐厅吃饭。
sentences.en: We're going to a vegetarian restaurant for dinner tonight.

sentences.zh: 因为今天是我朋友Jessica的生日，她是个素食主义者。
sentences.en: 'Cause it's my friend Jessica's birthday—she's a vegetarian.

sentences.zh: 这家店人可多了，还好我们提前定了个包间，要不周末根本没位置。
sentences.en: This place is packed—good thing we booked a private room, otherwise there's no way we'd get a table on the weekend.

sentences.zh: 哇刚才我们吃了个素汉堡，居然挺好吃的。
sentences.en: Wow, we just had a veggie burger—it was actually pretty good.

sentences.zh: 他们好像是用豆腐代替的肉。
sentences.en: I think they used tofu instead of meat.

sentences.zh: 这家炒的油麦菜也好好吃，是我吃过最好吃的。
sentences.en: Their stir-fried Chinese lettuce is amazing too—best I've ever had.

sentences.zh: 炒花菜也好好吃啊！
sentences.en: The stir-fried cauliflower is so good too!

sentences.zh: 素食餐厅居然这么贵，我们六个人点了八个菜，你猜多少钱？
sentences.en: I had no idea vegetarian food could be this expensive! Six of us ordered eight dishes—guess how much?
Nine hundred and thirty kuai!

sentences.zh: 真的太贵了，不过确实很好吃。
sentences.en: That's really pricey, but it was seriously delicious.

sentences.zh: 我要开始减肥了，你猜我今晚吃的什么？
sentences.en: I'm starting my diet—guess what I had for dinner tonight?

sentences.zh: 我吃了一小碗面条，一个鸡腿和一盘炒生菜。
sentences.en: I had a small bowl of noodles, a chicken drumstick, and a plate of stir-fried lettuce.

sentences.zh: 非常健康，碳水，蛋白质，膳食纤维都有了。
sentences.en: Super healthy—got my carbs, protein, and fiber all covered.

sentences.zh: 而且我今天吃的是煮鸡腿哦，我以前都是吃炸鸡腿的，我特别喜欢吃炸的东西。
sentences.en: And I had a boiled chicken drumstick today—I used to always eat fried ones, I'm obsessed with fried food.

sentences.zh: 一会儿我要去健身房健身，我找了一个私教。
sentences.en: I'm heading to the gym later—I got myself a personal trainer.

sentences.zh: 这个教练跟我说一定不可以节食，节食会掉肌肉，我肌肉太少了。
sentences.en: My trainer told me I absolutely can't starve myself—it'll make me lose muscle, and I already don't have much.

sentences.zh: 明天早餐我要吃鸡胸肉，鸡腿还是脂肪含量有点高了。
sentences.en: I'm having chicken breast for breakfast tomorrow—chicken drumsticks still have a bit too much fat.

sentences.zh: 希望我可以每周都瘦一公斤。
sentences.en: Hope I can lose a kilo every week.

sentences.zh: 今天也太难打车了，可能是因为下暴雨，感觉全世界的人都在打车。
sentences.en: It's so hard to get a ride today—probably 'cause of the downpour, feels like the whole world is trying to get a cab.

sentences.zh: 打了一个小时了，现在显示我前面还排了85个人。
sentences.en: I've been waiting for an hour—it says there are still eighty-five people ahead of me.

sentences.zh: 等下，我在高德上也打一下，两个app一起打。
sentences.en: Hold on, I'll try Amap too—running both apps.

sentences.zh: 笑死，高德显示我前面还有233个人。
sentences.en: Unbelievable, Amap says there are two hundred and thirty-three people ahead of me.

sentences.zh: 服了，6点就下班了，现在8点了还在办公室。
sentences.en: Seriously, I got off at six, and it's already eight and I'm still stuck in the office.

sentences.zh: 啊！终于有司机接单了！
sentences.en: Ah! Finally got a driver!

sentences.zh: 他又取消了.....
sentences.en: And he cancelled...

sentences.zh: 又有司机接单了，不过这个司机离我还有3公里。
sentences.en: Another driver accepted—but he's still three kilometers away.

sentences.zh: 没事我就等这个司机
sentences.en: Whatever, I'll just wait for this one.

sentences.zh: 我到家啦
sentences.en: Finally home!

sentences.zh: 我今天真的太倒霉了。
sentences.en: Today is just really not my day.

sentences.zh: 我早上打车去机场嘛，本来想用手机打的，但是正好过来一个出租车我就坐出租车了。
sentences.en: I was heading to the airport this morning—I was gonna order a ride on my phone, but a cab happened to pull up, so I just hopped in.

sentences.zh: 上车的时候我跟司机说得很清楚去机场T2航站楼，他还确认了一下说T2对吧，我说对，结果他还是把我送到了T3。
sentences.en: When I got in, I made it super clear that I needed Terminal 2—he even confirmed, 'T2, right?' and I said yeah. But he still dropped me off at T3.

sentences.zh: 我真服了，而且我上车的时候问他大概要多久，他说最多40分钟。
sentences.en: I can't even—and when I asked how long it'd take, he said 40 minutes tops.

sentences.zh: 结果我们一个多小时才到的机场，而且到的T3
sentences.en: Turns out it took over an hour to get to the airport—and to T3.

sentences.zh: 真的气死我了，我从T3走到T2还花了半个小时，然后我就没赶上飞机。
sentences.en: I'm so pissed—it took me another half hour just to walk from T3 to T2, so of course I missed my flight.

sentences.zh: 我现在又重新买了一班，又花了我400多块钱。
sentences.en: I just bought a new ticket—cost me another 400 bucks.

sentences.zh: 我要吃点好吃的平复一下心情。
sentences.en: I need some good food to cheer myself up.

sentences.zh: 我今天要坐船去一个小岛哦，这是我人生第一次坐船。
sentences.en: I'm taking a boat to an island today—it's my first time ever on a boat!

sentences.zh: 天呐没想到我居然晕船，刚吐了好几次。
sentences.en: Oh my god, I didn't expect to get seasick—I just threw up a bunch of times.

sentences.zh: 我现在已经下船了，我从来没有晕过车，没想到居然晕船。
sentences.en: I'm off the boat now—I never get carsick, so I had no idea I'd get seasick.

sentences.zh: 突然想起来我坐秋千也晕，可能船和秋千差不多。
sentences.en: Come to think of it, I get dizzy on swings too—maybe it's the same kind of motion.

sentences.zh: 明天我们还要坐船回去呢，我要先买点晕船药。
sentences.en: We gotta take the boat back tomorrow—I should get some motion sickness pills first.

sentences.zh: 那你说我以后还能坐大轮船吗？我朋友说大轮船很稳不会晕。
sentences.en: So do you think I can still go on a cruise in the future? My friend said big ships are super smooth and you don't really get sick.

sentences.zh: 反正就算晕也值得体验一下，我从来没坐过大轮船呢。
sentences.en: Anyway, even if I do get sick, it's still worth trying—I've never been on a big cruise before.

sentences.zh: 哇我刚才遇到一个车跟神经病样的。
sentences.en: Wow, I just saw a car driving like a total maniac.

sentences.zh: 那个车变道转向都不打灯的。
sentences.en: The car wasn't even signaling when changing lanes or turning!

sentences.zh: 而且我们在一个路口的时候，红灯哦，他直接左转走了。
sentences.en: And at an intersection—on a red light, mind you—the guy just ran the red light to turned left.

sentences.zh: 我现在要去找个充电站或者加油站，我车没电了，油也快没了。
sentences.en: I gotta find a charging spot or a gas station—my battery's basically dead, and I'm almost out of gas too.

sentences.zh: 加好油了，我们要去野餐啦。
sentences.en: All filled up! Now we're heading out for our picnic.

sentences.zh: 我这次准备了好多吃的喝的，整个后备箱都塞满了。
sentences.en: I packed so much food and drinks this time—the whole trunk is stuffed.

sentences.zh: 我真的服了，我居然没带野餐垫！
sentences.en: Are you kidding me—I forgot the picnic blanket!

sentences.zh: 我要去接Linda下班啦，晚上我们一起吃饭。
sentences.en: I'm gonna pick up Linda from work—we're having dinner together tonight.

sentences.zh: 不过我得卡着她下班的点去，因为她们公司门口不好停车。
sentences.en: But I gotta time it right for when she gets off, 'cause parking in front of her company is a pain.

sentences.zh: 我接到Linda了
sentences.en: Just picked Linda up!

sentences.zh: 天呐，前面出车祸了，有个车撞到护栏上了。
sentences.en: Oh no, there's an accident ahead—a car crashed into the guardrail.

sentences.zh: 好像是司机酒驾，还好没有撞到人。
sentences.en: Looks like the driver was drunk. Thankfully nobody got hit.

sentences.zh: 我刚就看这个车开的可快了，一直在超车。
sentences.en: I saw that car driving super fast earlier, constantly passing everyone!

sentences.zh: 前面写的限速40这个车也不减速。
sentences.en: The speed limit was only forty, and they still didn't slow down!

sentences.zh: 交警刚才把他带走了。
sentences.en: The cops just took him away.

sentences.zh: 午休时间到啦！我们午休一个半小时呢。
sentences.en: Lunch break's here! We get an hour and a half for lunch.

sentences.zh: 我要和同事一起去外面吃拉面。
sentences.en: I'm heading out with my coworkers to get some ramen.

sentences.zh: 我们公司的食堂真是越来越难吃，我们现在都不怎么去食堂了。
sentences.en: Our cafeteria food has been getting worse and worse—we barely eat there anymore.

sentences.zh: 我们部门同事关系可好了，每天都是我们四个人一起吃午饭。
sentences.en: Everyone in our department gets along so well—the four of us have lunch together every single day.

sentences.zh: 这个拉面真不错，比我们食堂好吃多了。
sentences.en: This ramen is so good—way better than our cafeteria.

sentences.zh: 我又回公司啦，玩会儿手机就要睡午觉了。
sentences.en: Back at the office now! Gonna scroll on my phone for a bit, then take a nap.

sentences.zh: 我这个椅子可以放平，睡午觉可舒服了。
sentences.en: My chair reclines all the way back, so taking a nap is super comfortable.

sentences.zh: 不跟你说了，我要睡午觉了。
sentences.en: Gotta go—time for my nap!

sentences.zh: 我下班啦！累死了，改了一下午PPT.
sentences.en: I'm off work! I'm exhausted—I spent the whole afternoon tweaking a slide deck.

sentences.zh: 真是太不容易了，这是这周第一次准时下班。
sentences.en: What a relief—this is the first time I'm leaving on time this week!

sentences.zh: 我今天要去一趟菜市场，我同事说菜市场的猕猴桃特别甜而且比超市便宜好多。
sentences.en: I'm hitting the farmers' market today—my coworker said the kiwis there are super sweet and way cheaper than at the supermarket.

sentences.zh: 我买好啦，刚才尝了一下真的超甜，我买了3公斤。
sentences.en: Got them! I just tried one and it's crazy sweet—I bought like six pounds of them.

sentences.zh: 不过现在又有了个新问题。
sentences.en: But now I've got a whole new problem.

sentences.zh: 我这个自行车没有后座也没有车筐，我的猕猴桃都没地方放。
sentences.en: My bike doesn't have a back rack or a basket, so there's nowhere to put these kiwis.

sentences.zh: 嗯...我只能把猕猴桃挂在车把上慢慢骑回去了。
sentences.en: Hmm... I guess I'll just hang the bag on the handlebars and ride back super slowly.

sentences.zh: 到家啦，我要点个外卖配上我的猕猴桃一起吃。
sentences.en: Finally home! Gonna order some takeout and enjoy it with my kiwis.

sentences.zh: 昨天晚上我室友一直打呼噜声音超级大。
sentences.en: Last night, my roommate was snoring so loudly all night.

sentences.zh: 我一整晚都没睡好，我还做了个噩梦。
sentences.en: I barely slept all night—and to top it off, I had a nightmare.

sentences.zh: 我梦到自己失眠了，然后半夜去散步，结果坐电梯的时候从20楼掉到1楼了。
sentences.en: I dreamed I had insomnia, so I went for a walk in the middle of the night, and then the elevator plummeted from the 20th(twentieth) floor to the 1st(first)!

sentences.zh: 吓死我了，我直接吓醒了。
sentences.en: It scared the life out of me—I woke up in a total panic.

sentences.zh: 我现在好困啊，我都快在工位上睡着了。
sentences.en: I'm so exhausted right now—I'm practically falling asleep at my desk.

sentences.zh: 希望我室友今晚不要再打呼噜了，可能她昨天是太累了。
sentences.en: Hopefully my roommate doesn't snore tonight—maybe she was just super tired yesterday.

sentences.zh: 或者我在网上给她买个防打呼神器怎么样？
sentences.en: Or should I buy her one of those anti-snoring gadgets online? What do you think?

sentences.zh: 我买了个大别墅，才花了5000万。
sentences.en: I just bought a huge mansion—and it only cost fifty million!

sentences.zh: 这个房子可好了，有个超大的游泳池。
sentences.en: This place is incredible—it's got a massive swimming pool.

sentences.zh: 还有个大车库，正好可以放下我的法拉利和宾利。
sentences.en: Plus a huge garage that fits my Ferrari and Bentley perfectly.

sentences.zh: 二楼还有个露台，平时可以在这看风景。
sentences.en: There's a terrace on the second floor where I can just relax and enjoy the view.

sentences.zh: 我要把地下室装修成KTV.
sentences.en: I'm gonna turn the basement into a karaoke room.

sentences.zh: 再放几个健身器材，每天健健身。
sentences.en: And put in some gym equipment so I can work out every day.

sentences.zh: 一楼就用来招待朋友，还可以在院子里开party
sentences.en: The first floor will be for hosting friends—we can even throw parties in the yard!

sentences.zh: 虽然房子只有三层，但是我还是打算装个电梯。
sentences.en: Even though it's only three stories, I'm still gonna put in an elevator.

sentences.zh: 没办法，有钱就是这么任性。
sentences.en: What can I say? That's just how you roll when you've got money.

sentences.zh: 我新买了床上四件套，是粉色的，超级好看！
sentences.en: I got a new bedding set! It's pink and super pretty.

sentences.zh: 我特别喜欢粉色，我的窗帘也是粉色。
sentences.en: I'm obsessed with pink—my curtains are pink, too.

sentences.zh: 现在我的床单被套枕套窗帘全都是粉色了。
sentences.en: Now my sheets, duvet cover, pillowcases, and curtains are all pink!

sentences.zh: 我还要买个淡蓝色的台灯放在床头柜上，淡蓝色我也很喜欢。
sentences.en: I'm also gonna get a light blue lamp for my nightstand—I'm a big fan of light blue, too.

sentences.zh: 我这个房间的墙奶白色的，地板是棕色的木地板，都是我喜欢的。
sentences.en: My room has creamy white walls and brown hardwood floors—everything is just my style.

sentences.zh: 唯一的不好就是我房间插座太少了。
sentences.en: The only downside is that there aren't enough outlets in my room.

sentences.zh: 我躺床上玩手机的时候都没法充电。
sentences.en: I can't even charge my phone while I'm lying in bed on my phone.

sentences.zh: 我一会儿得再买个插排才行，插排也要买粉色的。
sentences.en: I need to buy a power strip later—and yep, that's gotta be pink, too!

sentences.zh: 我今天干了一天的家务。
sentences.en: I've been doing chores all day today.

sentences.zh: 我一起床就把每个房间的地都拖了一遍。
sentences.en: As soon as I got up, I mopped the floor in every room.

sentences.zh: 还把衣柜里的衣服全都叠好了，之前可乱了。
sentences.en: I also folded all the clothes in my closet—it was a total mess before.

sentences.zh: 浴室的洗手台洗手池还有马桶浴缸我都擦的可干净了。
sentences.en: I scrubbed the bathroom counter, sink, toilet, and tub until they were spotless!

sentences.zh: 我还把所有的垃圾都扔出去了，还给每个垃圾桶都套上垃圾袋了。
sentences.en: I took out all the trash and put fresh bags in every bin.

sentences.zh: 好累啊，我要先上个厕所然后去睡一觉。
sentences.en: I'm so exhausted—gonna use the bathroom real quick and then take a nap.

sentences.zh: 天呐马桶堵了，是我的屎太硬了吗？
sentences.en: Oh gosh, the toilet's clogged—Was my poop really that hard or something?

sentences.zh: 我弄了半天还是没弄好。
sentences.en: I messed with it for so long and still couldn't unclog it.

sentences.zh: 好恶心哦，我把马桶盖盖上了，不想看到。
sentences.en: It's so gross—I just shut the lid 'cause I can't even look at it.

sentences.zh: 我刚买了个疏通剂等我睡醒了试试。
sentences.en: I just ordered some toilet unclogger—I'll try it after my nap.

sentences.zh: 我买了一块新地毯，超级好看，是那种杏色的。
sentences.en: I bought a new rug! It's so pretty—it's like a soft apricot beige.

sentences.zh: 这个地毯跟我沙发的颜色可配了，沙发是棕色。
sentences.en: It matches my brown sofa perfectly.

sentences.zh: 而且本来沙发旁边就放了一个杏色的灯，现在这三个搭配起来真是太好看了。
sentences.en: Plus, I already had an apricot lamp next to the couch, so all three together look amazing!

sentences.zh: 我真是一个好有审美的人！
sentences.en: I swear I've got such good taste.

sentences.zh: 天呐我真服了自己了，我刚把咖啡洒在地毯上了。
sentences.en: Oh my god, I literally can't with myself—I just spilled coffee all over the rug!

sentences.zh: 还好这个地毯比较薄，商家说可以放洗衣机洗。
sentences.en: Luckily it's pretty thin, and the seller said it's machine-washable.

sentences.zh: 气死我了，以后再也不在地毯旁边喝咖啡了！
sentences.en: I'm so annoyed—never drinking coffee anywhere near this rug again!

sentences.zh: 哇洗衣机洗的好干净呀，地毯像新的一样。
sentences.en: Wow, the washing machine got the stain right out—the rug looks good as new!

sentences.zh: 我想租个房子，看了好几个都不太满意。
sentences.en: I wanna rent an apartment, but I've looked at a few and none of them feel quite right.

sentences.zh: 有一个房子挺漂亮的，但是没有地暖。
sentences.en: One place was really nice, but it didn't have heated floors.

sentences.zh: 还有一个房子哪哪都挺好，但是离地铁站太远了。
sentences.en: Another one was great in every way, except it was way too far from the subway.

sentences.zh: 还有一个房子很便宜，但是里面太破了，就是那种老破小，而且没电梯。
sentences.en: There was a cheap one, but it was super run-down—just an old, tiny place with no elevator.

sentences.zh: 最后看的那个房子又太高了，32楼，我站窗户旁边都害怕。
sentences.en: The last one was on the 32nd(thirty-second) floor—too high up! I got scared just standing by the window.

sentences.zh: 其实也有好的房子，但是我的预算只有2500块钱。
sentences.en: Honestly, there are good places out there, but my budget is only twenty-five hundred.

sentences.zh: 我要是有5000万就好了，我马上就去买个别墅。
sentences.en: If I had fifty million, I'd go buy a mansion right this second!

sentences.zh: 我去买个彩票去，看能不能中5000万。
sentences.en: I'm gonna go buy a lottery ticket and see if I can win fifty million.

sentences.zh: 妈呀，今天这个天都不是热，是烫，体感温度至少42度了。
sentences.en: Oh my god, today isn't just hot—it's straight-up scorching! Feels like at least forty-two degrees out there.

sentences.zh: 我一到家就赶紧把空调打开了，先开18度赶紧把温度降下来。
sentences.en: As soon as I got home, I blasted the AC—set it to eighteen to cool the place down fast.

sentences.zh: 啊凉快多了，我现在又调到26度了。
sentences.en: Ah, so much better—I set it back to twenty-six now.

sentences.zh: 一直18度的话，冷是其次，关键是费钱啊。
sentences.en: Keeping it at eighteen isn't just about being cold—the main thing is it's way too expensive!

sentences.zh: 现在电费真的很夸张，我上周一交了150，昨天就用没了。
sentences.en: Electricity bills are insane lately—I put a hundred and fifty on it last Monday, and it was already gone by yesterday.

sentences.zh: 我又去冰箱拿了半个冰镇西瓜出来，用勺子挖着吃。
sentences.en: Then I grabbed half a chilled watermelon from the fridge and started scooping it out with a spoon.

sentences.zh: 啊太幸福了，我感觉我整个人都活过来了。
sentences.en: Ah, this is pure bliss—I feel like I'm coming back to life!

sentences.zh: 夏天的命真的是空调给的，没空调我早中暑了。
sentences.en: AC is literally a lifesaver in the summer—without it, I would've had heatstroke by now.

sentences.zh: 我高数挂了....
sentences.en: I failed calculus...

sentences.zh: 还有一个选修课也挂了。
sentences.en: And I failed an elective, too.

sentences.zh: 这门课我本来就不喜欢，但是我选的时候别的课都满了，我只能选这个。
sentences.en: I didn't even like the class, but when I registered, every other elective was full, so I was stuck with it.

sentences.zh: 我现在只能等大二的时候再重修了。
sentences.en: Now I just have to wait until sophomore year to retake the course.

sentences.zh: 好伤心啊，要是补考也不过，我就不能毕业了。
sentences.en: It sucks so bad—if I fail it again, I won't even be able to graduate!

sentences.zh: 不过我其它5个室友这门课也都挂了，我们可以一起重修。
sentences.en: On the bright side, my other five roommates all failed it too, so at least.we can retake it together.

sentences.zh: 这个选修课的老师特别严，只要你旷课一次平时分就是0分。
sentences.en: The professor for that elective is super strict—if you skip class even once, your participation grade is a zero.

sentences.zh: 唉，明年重修一节课都不能逃了。
sentences.en: Sigh, when I retake it next year, I literally can't skip a single class.

sentences.zh: 我期末考试语文才考了85
sentences.en: I only got an eighty-five on my Chinese final.

sentences.zh: 我平常都能考130多的，这次是因为作文跑题了。
sentences.en: I usually get above one hundred and thirty—it's just that my essay went totally off-topic this time.

sentences.zh: 不过我英语和历史都考的挺好的。
sentences.en: But I did pretty well in English and history.

sentences.zh: 化学和政治也进步了。
sentences.en: My chemistry and politics scores went up, too.

sentences.zh: 我还是挺厉害的，要是作文不跑题，这次能考我们班前三了。
sentences.en: I'm still pretty awesome—if my essay hadn't gone off-topic, I would've been in the top three in my class.

sentences.zh: 下午语文老师就要来讲卷子，他肯定会骂我的。
sentences.en: The Chinese teacher is gonna go over the test this afternoon, and he's definitely gonna chew me out.

sentences.zh: 我是我们班唯一一个不及格的人，而且我还是语文课代表。
sentences.en: I'm the only person in class who failed, and I'm literally the Chinese class rep!

sentences.zh: 好想找个理由请假回家，不想上语文课。
sentences.en: I really wanna come up with an excuse to go home early—I just don't wanna deal with Chinese class.

sentences.zh: 我们学校的食堂真是太难吃了。
sentences.en: Our school cafeteria is so awful.

sentences.zh: 也不能说食堂难吃，是我们高中部的食堂难吃，小学和初中的食堂都可好吃了。
sentences.en: Well, I shouldn't say the whole school—it's just the high school cafeteria. The elementary and middle school ones are actually really good.

sentences.zh: 我妹妹上初二嘛，他们食堂昨天中午给他们做的炸鸡呢。
sentences.en: My sister's an 8th(eighth) grader, and their cafeteria served fried chicken for lunch yesterday!

sentences.zh: 我刚听一个4年级的小学生说，他们今天中午吃的螃蟹。
sentences.en: I literally just heard a 4th(fourth) grader say they had crab for lunch today.

sentences.zh: 太不公平了，我们就只有大米饭和炒菜，菜还没有一个我爱吃的。
sentences.en: That is so unfair—we just get plain rice and stir-fry, and not a single dish is something I actually like.

sentences.zh: 好在我现在已经高二了，再熬一年我就能上大学了。
sentences.en: Good thing I'm already a junior—just gotta stick it out for one more year, and I'm off to college.

sentences.zh: 我们老师说等我们上了大学，每天想吃什么吃什么。
sentences.en: My teacher said once we get into college, we can eat whatever we want every day.

sentences.zh: 到时候我要先吃一个星期的火锅。
sentences.en: When that happens, I'm gonna eat hot pot every single day for a week straight!

sentences.zh: 我们下午的体育课又上不成了。
sentences.en: Our PE class this afternoon got canceled again.

sentences.zh: 被语文老师占了，他是我们班主任，他想占就占。
sentences.en: The Chinese teacher stole it—he's our homeroom teacher, so he basically does whatever he wants.

sentences.zh: 上周的体育课也是被语文老师占了。
sentences.en: He took over last week's PE class, too.

sentences.zh: 自从上了高三，体育课几乎都没怎么上过，因为快高考了。
sentences.en: Ever since senior year started, we've barely had PE—just because the Gaokao is coming up.

sentences.zh: 可是我真的很喜欢上体育课，想去操场玩。
sentences.en: But I actually love PE class—I just wanna hang out on the sports field.

sentences.zh: 初三的时候也没怎么上体育课，因为要中考。
sentences.en: We barely had PE in 9th grade either, all because of the high school entrance exam.

sentences.zh: 还是上小学最幸福了，不对，是上幼儿园最幸福了。
sentences.en: Elementary school was the best—actually, wait, kindergarten was the absolute best.

sentences.zh: 下午还有一节生物课，生物我也不喜欢。
sentences.en: We also have biology this afternoon, and I can't stand biology either.

sentences.zh: 九月份大学开学我就要住校啦，这是我第一次住校。
sentences.en: I'm moving into the dorms when college starts in September—it'll be my first time living on campus.

sentences.zh: 我听说我们学校的宿舍挺好的呢。
sentences.en: I heard the dorms at my school are actually pretty nice.

sentences.zh: 他们说本科生是六人间，而且有独立卫生间。
sentences.en: They say undergrads get six-person rooms with their own bathroom.

sentences.zh: 最最最重要的是，我在网上看到有学姐说每个宿舍都有空调。
sentences.en: Best of all, I saw some upperclassmen say online that every room has AC!

sentences.zh: 不知道我的室友人怎么样，希望都是好相处的人。
sentences.en: I wonder what my roommates are gonna be like—I just hope they're all easy to get along with.

sentences.zh: 我要把我所有的毛绒玩具都带过去。
sentences.en: I'm definitely bringing all my stuffed animals with me.

sentences.zh: 我还要带一个厚褥子过去，我喜欢软软的床。
sentences.en: I'm also bringing a thick mattress topper—I love a soft bed.

sentences.zh: 被子也要带两个，薄的厚的都要带。
sentences.en: I gotta bring two blankets, too—a light one and a heavy one.

sentences.zh: 无语，9点就来图书馆了，结果一个带插座的座位都没有了。
sentences.en: I can't even—I got to the library right at nine, and there wasn't a single seat with an outlet left.

sentences.zh: 刚才好不容易找到一个座位，结果对面的人说这个座位有人了。
sentences.en: I finally managed to find a spot, but the person across from me said it was taken.

sentences.zh: 不带插座的座位也不多了，看起来空座位很多，但是好多都被占了。
sentences.en: There aren't many regular seats left either—it looks like there are plenty of empties, but most of them are saved.

sentences.zh: 我现在找到了一个窗边不带插排的座位，晒死我了。
sentences.en: I found a spot by the window without an outlet, and I'm literally baking in the sun right now.

sentences.zh: 这个窗帘也坏了，都拉不下来。
sentences.en: The blinds are broken, too—they won't even pull down.

sentences.zh: 算了我还是回宿舍吧。
sentences.en: Forget it, I'm just gonna head back to the dorm.

sentences.zh: 宿舍至少能插电，可以用电脑。
sentences.en: At least in the dorm I can plug in my laptop and actually get work done.

sentences.zh: 我先去借本书，以后8点半之后再也不来图书馆了。
sentences.en: I'm gonna check out a book first—and after this, I'm never coming to the library after eight-thirty again!

sentences.zh: 我手机被没收了，现在用一个旧手机跟你聊天呢。
sentences.en: My phone got confiscated—I'm talking to you on an old one right now.

sentences.zh: 今天上课的时候，我忘记给手机开静音了，有人给我打电话，我手机就响了。
sentences.en: During class today, I forgot to put my phone on silent, and it started ringing when someone called me.

sentences.zh: 当时我们正在上化学课，吓死我了，老师说：谁的手机在响？我都不敢说话。
sentences.en: We were in chemistry class—it scared the living daylights out of me! The teacher was like, "Whose phone is ringing?" I didn't even dare to breathe.

sentences.zh: 但是我手机一直响，老师就走过来了，让我把手机交给他。
sentences.en: But my phone just kept ringing, so the teacher walked over and made me hand it in.

sentences.zh: 我其实上课从来不玩手机的，就下课玩一会儿。
sentences.en: I never even mess around on my phone in class—I only use it during breaks.

sentences.zh: 老师下课把我叫到办公室说让我明天让家长去学校拿手机。
sentences.en: After class, the teacher called me into the office and told me my parents have to come pick it up tomorrow.

sentences.zh: 我还没跟我爸妈说呢，他们肯定会骂我的，万一揍我怎么办?
sentences.en: I haven't told my parents yet—they're definitely gonna chew me out. What if they ground me or even beat me?

sentences.zh: 啊啊啊啊我拿到offer了！这个公司是我最想去的。
sentences.en: Ahhhh I got the offer! This is literally my dream company!

sentences.zh: 本来笔试能过我就已经很惊喜了，没想到面试也过了。
sentences.en: I was already thrilled just passing the written exam—I never thought I'd make it through the interview, too!

sentences.zh: 可能我简历写的比较好，我专门让一个大厂的朋友帮我修改了一下呢。
sentences.en: Maybe my resume was just that good—I actually had a friend at a big tech company help me polish it.

sentences.zh: 太不容易了，他们让我下周一就去上班，好期待。
sentences.en: It's been such a ride—they want me to start next Monday, and I can't wait!

sentences.zh: 这个工作每天早上9点上班，下午5点半就下班了，而且中午休息一个半小时呢。
sentences.en: The hours are nine to five-thirty with an hour-and-a-half lunch break.

sentences.zh: 而且工资我也很满意，每个月到手能拿5000多呢
sentences.en: And I'm really happy with the pay—I'll be taking home over five thousand a month.

sentences.zh: 而且社保公积金也都有。
sentences.en: Plus, they cover social insurance and housing fund.

sentences.zh: 我真是太幸运了！希望同事也都很好相处。
sentences.en: I'm so lucky! I just hope my coworkers are all easy to get along with.

sentences.zh: 妈呀我们马上要开会了，但是打印机坏了，这个文件我会上要用呢。
sentences.en: Oh man, our meeting is about to start and the printer is broken—I need this document for the meeting!

sentences.zh: 本来早上就打印好了，但是我又修改了一下就得重新打。
sentences.en: I had already printed it this morning, but I made a few changes, so I had to print it again.

sentences.zh: 啊没事了，我去前台打好了。
sentences.en: Oh, never mind—I got it printed at the front desk.

sentences.zh: 周会真无聊，我们经理一个人就说了快一个小时。
sentences.en: Weekly meetings are so boring—our manager went on for almost an hour all by himself.

sentences.zh: 每次开会前他都说：我简单说两句。结果每次都说一个小时。
sentences.en: Before every meeting he's like, "I'll keep it short," but then he goes on for a full hour!

sentences.zh: 正常这个时间点都该下班了，但是现在我们还在开会
sentences.en: Normally we'd be off work by now, but here we are, still stuck in this meeting.

sentences.zh: 好饿啊这个会到底什么时候能结束？
sentences.en: I'm starving—when is this meeting ever gonna end?

sentences.zh: 啊终于结束啦！我要出吃饭了！
sentences.en: Ah, it's finally over! I'm heading out to grab some food!

sentences.zh: 跟你宣布一个大事，我今天终于提离职了！
sentences.en: Big news—I finally put in my two weeks today!

sentences.zh: 虽然我还没找到新工作，但是这个工作我是真的干不下去了。
sentences.en: I don't even have a new job lined up, but I seriously couldn't take it anymore.

sentences.zh: 我从去年7月入职到现在从来没有休过一个完整的周末，而且基本上都是晚上9点以后才下班的。
sentences.en: I haven't had a single full weekend off since I started last July, and I'm pretty much never off work before nine PM.

sentences.zh: 我提离职的时候领导说可以每个月给我涨500块钱，我没同意。
sentences.en: When I handed in my resignation, my boss offered me a five-hundred-yuan monthly raise, but I turned it down.

sentences.zh: 我本来一个月也就4500，给我涨500也才5000块钱，5000块钱就想买我的命，我才不干呢。
sentences.en: I only make forty-five hundred a month—an extra five hundred only brings it to five thousand. My life is worth way more than five thousand yuan, no chance!

sentences.zh: 我现在感觉特别轻松，特别爽，有一种终于解脱了的感觉。
sentences.en: I feel so relieved right now—it literally feels like a weight off my shoulders.

sentences.zh: 我晚上要跟朋友出去庆祝一下，我们要去吃火锅。
sentences.en: I'm going out with friends tonight to celebrate—we're getting hotpot!

sentences.zh: 我现在的工作工资好低啊。
sentences.en: My current job pays peanuts.

sentences.zh: 我一个月到手都不到3000，但是换工作也不太可能，现在到处都在裁员。
sentences.en: I take home less than three thousand a month, but switching jobs isn't really an option with layoffs everywhere.

sentences.zh: 我在考虑找个兼职，反正我每天6点就下班了。
sentences.en: I'm thinking about picking up a side hustle—I get off work at six every day anyway.

sentences.zh: 但是做什么兼职呢？
sentences.en: But what kind of side hustle should I do?

sentences.zh: 我挺想去做家教的，但是家教基本都是大学生在做，我都毕业好几年了。
sentences.en: I kind of want to tutor, but that's mostly for college students, and I've been out of school for years.

sentences.zh: 好穷啊，我什么时候才能升职加薪。
sentences.en: I'm so broke—when am I ever gonna get a raise and a promotion?

sentences.zh: 我要是能赚到100万我立马退休。
sentences.en: If I could just make a million, I'd retire on the spot.

sentences.zh: 但现实是可能我还没赚到10万我就失业了。
sentences.en: But in reality, I'll probably get laid off before I even make 100,000(a hundred thousand).

sentences.zh: 今天我们部门来了一个新同事，叫Alice,长得挺可爱的。
sentences.en: A new coworker joined our team today—her name's Alice, and she's pretty cute.

sentences.zh: 她性格真的超级内向，和别人说话的时候眼睛都不敢看对方。
sentences.en: She's seriously introverted—she can't even make eye contact when talking to people.

sentences.zh: 老板让她做自我介绍，她一站起来脸和脖子全都红透了。
sentences.en: When the boss asked her to introduce herself, she stood up and her whole face and neck turned bright red.

sentences.zh: 她就说：”我叫Alice，能和大家一起工作很开心。”就立刻坐下了。
sentences.en: She just said, "I'm Alice, so happy to be working with everyone," and sat right back down.

sentences.zh: 我其实特别能理解她的感受，因为我以前也是个很内向的人。
sentences.en: I totally get where she's coming from—I used to be super introverted, too.

sentences.zh: 我明天打算主动请她喝杯咖啡，帮她放松一下。
sentences.en: I'm planning to grab a coffee for her tomorrow to help her break the ice.

sentences.zh: 你说我明天早上给她带个小礼物怎么样？
sentences.en: What do you think—should I bring her a little gift tomorrow morning?

sentences.zh: 我打算给她带个绿植，可以放在办公桌上。
sentences.en: I'm thinking of getting her a small plant for her desk.

sentences.zh: 客户说给我发了个邮件让我确认一下，但是我收件箱里什么都没有。
sentences.en: The client said they sent me an email to confirm, but there's nothing in my inbox.

sentences.zh: 垃圾箱也没有，甚至发件箱也找了都没有。
sentences.en: Nothing in spam either—I even checked my outbox.

sentences.zh: 奥是客户发错邮箱了。。。。
sentences.en: Oh, turns out the client sent it to the wrong email address...

sentences.zh: 真服了，又是修改意见，这版PPT我都修改7遍了。
sentences.en: I can't even—it's another round of revisions! I've already edited this deck seven times!

sentences.zh: 这个客户真的是我遇到过最难伺候的甲方。
sentences.en: This client is seriously the most high-maintenance client I've ever dealt with.

sentences.zh: 光是素材图就让我找了400多个，建了20个文件夹。
sentences.en: Just for stock images alone, they made me source over four hundred of them and organize them into twenty folders!

sentences.zh: 而且修改意见明明可以直接微信发给我，他们每次都要发邮件。
sentences.en: And they could've just messaged me the feedback, but they insist on emailing every single time.

sentences.zh: 气死我了，刚才他们说还是想要第一版PPT。
sentences.en: I'm so furious—they just told me they actually want to go with the very first draft!

sentences.zh: 我今天谈成了一个大单！客户终于把合同签了。
sentences.en: I closed a huge deal today! The client finally signed the contract!

sentences.zh: 这一单有60万呢，我可以拿百分之2的提成！
sentences.en: This deal is worth six hundred thousand—I get a two percent commission on it!

sentences.zh: 好开心啊，老板说我今年的年终奖会是去年的3倍。
sentences.en: I'm so stoked—my boss said my year-end bonus this year will be triple what I got last year!

sentences.zh: 客户今天还夸我特别细心特别有耐心。
sentences.en: The client even complimented me today for being super detail-oriented and patient.

sentences.zh: 客户给的拍摄素材我都是备份好几份，网盘，硬盘，存储卡全都备份一遍。
sentences.en: I backed up all the footage they gave me across multiple places—cloud, hard drive, memory card, you name it.

sentences.zh: 我现在还有几张表要填，填完就可以下班啦。
sentences.en: I still have a few forms to fill out, and then I can call it a day!

sentences.zh: 晚上我要去酒吧好好庆祝一下！
sentences.en: I'm hitting the bar tonight to celebrate big time!

sentences.zh: 刚我朋友amy给我发了一张照片让我帮她P一下。
sentences.en: My friend Amy just sent me a photo and asked me to Photoshop it for her.

sentences.zh: 我跟你说，我真的超会P图。
sentences.en: I'm not gonna lie, I'm actually a photo editing wizard.

sentences.zh: 她这个是拍的海边，有好多路人，她想把路人都P掉
sentences.en: It's a beach photo with a bunch of people in the background, and she wants them edited out.

sentences.zh: 太简单了，其实也不是我技术好，是因为我是会员。
sentences.en: Super easy—honestly it's not even my skills, it's just 'cause I have a premium subscription.

sentences.zh: 会员可以一键把路人都P掉。
sentences.en: Premium users can remove photobombers with just one tap.

sentences.zh: P好了，其实还是能看到点人影，不过不放大看的话看不出来。
sentences.en: All done—there's still a bit of a faint outline, but you can't really tell unless you zoom in.

sentences.zh: 她要把这个图做vlog的封面呢
sentences.en: She's gonna use this picture for her vlog thumbnail.

sentences.zh: 我这个朋友是个vlog博主，可厉害了，有好几万粉丝。
sentences.en: My friend is a vlogger, and she's actually pretty huge—she has tens of thousands of followers!

sentences.zh: 我好喜欢看吃播，但是我喜欢的一个博主已经三个月没更新了。
sentences.en: I love watching mukbangs, but one of my favorite creators hasn't posted in three months.

sentences.zh: 现在评论区都是催更的。
sentences.en: Now the comment section is full of people begging for a new video.

sentences.zh: 妈呀她居然是生病了，都上热搜了。
sentences.en: Oh gosh, turns out she's sick—it's actually trending right now!

sentences.zh: 可能是平常吃太多了，把身体吃坏了。
sentences.en: It's probably from overeating all the time—she wrecked her health.

sentences.zh: 以前我还在网上为她和别人吵过架呢。
sentences.en: I actually got into online arguments defending her before.

sentences.zh: 有个人一直发弹幕和评论说她是假吃，我说她是真吃，那个人就开始发私信骂我。
sentences.en: Someone kept leaving comments and sending live chat messages saying she spits her food out. I said she actually eats it, and the guy started sending me DMs to insult me.

sentences.zh: 反正最后我把那个人拉黑了。
sentences.en: Anyway, I ended up blocking them.

sentences.zh: 天呐希望这个博主可以早日康复。
sentences.en: Man, I really hope she makes a full recovery soon.

sentences.zh: 她不吃那么多我也爱看的。
sentences.en: I'd still watch her videos even if she didn't eat so much.

sentences.zh: 我们现在在迪士尼门口排队呢，人超级多。
sentences.en: We're standing in line at the Disneyland gate right now—it's so packed!

sentences.zh: 工作日就没这么多人，但是我们只有周末有时间。
sentences.en: Weekdays aren't nearly as crowded, but weekends are all we've got.

sentences.zh: 啊终于进来了，我们要先去玩加勒比海盗。
sentences.en: Ah, finally inside! We're hitting Pirates of the Caribbean first.

sentences.zh: 加勒比海盗真的是百刷不厌，太好玩了。
sentences.en: Pirates of the Caribbean never gets old—it's so ridiculously fun!

sentences.zh: 这是我在迪士尼最最最喜欢玩的项目。
sentences.en: This is my absolute number one ride in the whole park.

sentences.zh: 游街要开始啦！我马上就可以见到贝儿了！
sentences.en: The parade is about to start! I'm about to see LinaBell!

sentences.zh: 啊啊啊啊贝儿跳舞太可爱了！
sentences.en: Ahhhh Bell looks so cute dancing!

sentences.zh: 我们刚从鬼屋出来，现在要去找个好位置等着看烟花秀了。
sentences.en: We just got off Haunted Mansion, and now we're gonna stake out a good spot for the fireworks!

sentences.zh: 天呐太幸福了！在迪士尼看烟花是世界上最幸福的事。
sentences.en: Oh my god, this is pure bliss—watching the Disneyland fireworks is literally the best feeling in the world!

sentences.zh: 我这个周末过的太充实了。
sentences.en: I had such a packed weekend!

sentences.zh: 我周六上午和朋友去看了个画展，下午去逛了博物馆，晚上去看了个音乐剧，周天你猜我干嘛了？
sentences.en: Saturday morning I went to an art exhibition with a friend, in the afternoon I checked out a museum, and that night I saw a musical. Guess what I did on Sunday?

sentences.zh: 我居然钓了一天鱼！
sentences.en: I actually went fishing all day!

sentences.zh: 我钓上了两条大鱼一条小鱼，我们当晚就吃掉了。
sentences.en: I caught two big fish and a small one, and we cooked them up that same night!

sentences.zh: 这是我第一次钓鱼，没想到就彻底爱上了。
sentences.en: It was my very first time fishing, and I totally got hooked!

sentences.zh: 我们计划下周去滑雪，我都不想去了，想改成钓鱼。
sentences.en: We planned to go skiing next week, but now I don't even wanna go—I just wanna go fishing instead.

sentences.zh: 不过我之前都跟朋友约好了，所以下周还是会去滑雪的。
sentences.en: But I already made plans with my friends, so I'll still go skiing.

sentences.zh: 下下周的周末我要再去钓鱼。
sentences.en: The weekend after next, though, I'm definitely going fishing again!

sentences.zh: 我明天要跟朋友去爬山。
sentences.en: I'm going hiking with a friend tomorrow!

sentences.zh: 我已经好几年没爬过山了，我都怕我晕在半路。
sentences.en: I haven't been hiking in years—I'm genuinely scared I might pass out halfway through.

sentences.zh: 我要多带点吃的防止自己低血糖。
sentences.en: I need to bring extra snacks in case my blood sugar drops.

sentences.zh: 反正我要是爬不动了我就坐缆车。
sentences.en: Either way, if I can't make it, I'm just gonna take the cable car.

sentences.zh: 下山我肯定是要坐缆车的，下山伤膝盖。
sentences.en: I'm definitely taking the cable car down—going downhill is so bad on the knees!

sentences.zh: 我这个朋友体力可好了，她每个周末都去徒步。
sentences.en: My friend has incredible stamina—she goes hiking every single weekend.

sentences.zh: 你说山里会不会有蛇呀？
sentences.en: Do you think there'll be snakes out there in the mountains?

sentences.zh: 我得穿长裤长袖才行。
sentences.en: I gotta cover up with long sleeves and long pants just to be safe.

sentences.zh: 我们出来露营了，这个山里居然一点信号都没有。
sentences.en: We're out camping, and there's literally no service in these mountains!

sentences.zh: 我本来以为只是没有 WiFi，没想到是根本没有信号。
sentences.en: I thought there just wouldn't be WiFi—I didn't expect to have zero cell service!

sentences.zh: 本来我朋友还有点网呢，下午还给我开热点了，现在他手机也没信号了。
sentences.en: My friend actually had some signal earlier and even gave me a hotspot this afternoon, but now he's got no signal either.

sentences.zh: 刚上山的时候我手机还是5G,后来变成4G，现在是啥都没有了。
sentences.en: When we were coming up the mountain, I had 5G—then it dropped to 4G—and now I have no bars at all!

sentences.zh: 我们只能一起躺在帐篷里看星星了。
sentences.en: So now we're just lying in the tent together, stargazing.

sentences.zh: 我们这个帐篷顶是透明的，可好看了。
sentences.en: Our tent has a clear roof—it looks so cool!

sentences.zh: 听着音乐看风景好开心呀，没有网也没关系了。
sentences.en: Listening to music and taking in the view feels so nice—I don't even care about having no internet anymore.

sentences.zh: 有一种远离现代都市生活的感觉。
sentences.en: It really feels like getting off the grid.

sentences.zh: 我今天早上看了一个电影特别好看，女主超级励志，她从小就练摔跤，最后拿了金牌。
sentences.en: I watched an amazing movie this morning—the female lead was super inspiring. She trained in wrestling since she was a kid and ended up winning gold!

sentences.zh: 我忘记电影叫啥名字了，反正我就很喜欢看这种好结局的电影，结局不好的我都不爱看。
sentences.en: I blanked on the name, but I'm a sucker for happy endings—I just can't stand sad movies.

sentences.zh: 我看电影的时候就会觉得好像是我自己经历的这一切一样，所以我只喜欢看这种好结局的电影。
sentences.en: When I'm watching a movie, I feel like I'm actually living through it myself, so I need that good ending.

sentences.zh: 不过我也挺喜欢看动作戏的，比如史密斯夫妇这种。
sentences.en: But I do like action flicks too, like Mr. & Mrs. Smith.

sentences.zh: 我超喜欢史密斯夫人，她太美了！
sentences.en: I absolutely love Mrs. Smith—she is just drop-dead gorgeous!

sentences.zh: 跟你说的我又想看史密斯夫妇了，我现在要下楼扔垃圾，一会儿回来我要再把这个电影看一遍。
sentences.en: Talking about it makes me wanna watch it all over again. I'm gonna run downstairs to take out the trash, and I'm totally rewatching it when I get back!

sentences.zh: 哎我遥控器咋找不到了。
sentences.en: Wait, where did my remote go?

sentences.zh: 找到了。
sentences.en: Ah, there it is!

sentences.zh: 我看了一晚上的甄嬛传，太好看了天呐。
sentences.en: I've been watching Empresses in the Palace all night—it's so ridiculously good, oh my god!

sentences.zh: 我本来想就看一集的，结果直接看了个通宵。
sentences.en: I only planned on watching one episode, but I ended up pulling an all-nighter.

sentences.zh: 怪不得这部剧那么火，真的好好看，根本停不下来。
sentences.en: No wonder this show is such a huge hit—it's so addictive, I literally can't stop.

sentences.zh: 我现在才看到15集，本来想2倍速看的，但是又怕错过细节。
sentences.en: I'm only on episode fifteen—I thought about watching it at two times speed, but I was afraid I'd miss all the little details.

sentences.zh: 这个剧情真的是一环扣一环，一个废镜头的都没有。
sentences.en: The plotting is so tight—every single scene has a purpose, not a single wasted frame!

sentences.zh: 而且每个演员都演的好好啊。
sentences.en: Plus, every single actor is killing it!

sentences.zh: 不过我现在实在太困了，我要先睡一会起来再看。
sentences.en: But I am completely exhausted now—gonna crash for a bit and jump right back in when I wake up.

sentences.zh: 我这几天打算不出门了，就在家看这个剧。
sentences.en: I'm just gonna stay in for the next few days and keep watching it.

sentences.zh: 你喜欢看什么类型的综艺？
sentences.en: What kind of variety shows do you like watching?

sentences.zh: 我喜欢看脱口秀和喜剧大赛，旅行类综艺也挺喜欢的。
sentences.en: I love stand-up comedy and comedy sketch shows—I'm pretty into travel shows too.

sentences.zh: 喜剧大赛每一季我都看了，每个作品都看了好几遍，台词我都能背下来。
sentences.en: I've watched every single season of the comedy sketch show and rewatched each sketch multiple times—I practically have all the lines memorized!

sentences.zh: 我还经常去看线下的脱口秀呢，比看线上的更有意思。
sentences.en: I actually go to live stand-up shows all the time—the energy is way better than watching online!

sentences.zh: 我一个朋友特别喜欢看恋综，但是我对恋综没什么兴趣。
sentences.en: A friend of mine is obsessed with dating shows, but they're just not really my thing.

sentences.zh: 不过我们俩都很喜欢看旅行类综艺。
sentences.en: But both of us love travel shows.

sentences.zh: 看这种综艺就觉得像是自己也跟着去旅游了一样。
sentences.en: Watching them makes you feel like you're right there traveling with them.

sentences.zh: 等我有钱了我一定要环游世界！
sentences.en: Once I make bank, I'm definitely traveling the world!

sentences.zh: 我最近在追一部韩剧超级好看。
sentences.en: I've been super into this K-drama lately—it's so ridiculously good!

sentences.zh: 预告片出来的时候就特别吸引我。
sentences.en: The trailer had me hooked the moment I saw it.

sentences.zh: 现在国内更新到第7集了，但其实第8集已经出来了，只是没有中文字幕。
sentences.en: Up to episode seven is subbed in Chinese now, but episode eight is actually already out—just without subs yet.

sentences.zh: 这部剧的片头片尾曲也都特别好听，我都舍不得跳过。
sentences.en: The intro and outro tracks are so good too—I can't even bring myself to skip them.

sentences.zh: 一集40分钟但是我每次都要看一个多小时，你知道为什么吗？
sentences.en: Each episode is only forty minutes, but it takes me over an hour to finish—wanna guess why?

sentences.zh: 因为精彩的镜头我都要倒回去再看几遍。
sentences.en: 'Cause I keep rewinding all the good scenes to rewatch them!

sentences.zh: 而且有的镜头风景特别漂亮我还会暂停截图。
sentences.en: Plus, some of the shots are so gorgeous I have to pause and take screenshots.

sentences.zh: 我现在天天等更新，连花絮我都看完了。
sentences.en: I'm just living for the updates every day—I've even watched all the behind-the-scenes footage.

sentences.zh: 我昨天去看了一个电影，真是太难看了。
sentences.en: I went to see a movie yesterday—it was so bad!

sentences.zh: 本来上映之前我可期待了，没想到这么难看，真是大失所望。
sentences.en: I was so hyped before it came out, but it turned out terrible. What a huge letdown!

sentences.zh: 我看这个电影刚才宣布撤档了，估计是因为票房实在太低了。
sentences.en: I just saw they pulled it from theaters—probably because the box office numbers bombed so hard.

sentences.zh: 这个电影号称投资几个亿呢，不知道钱都花哪去了。
sentences.en: Supposedly it had a budget of hundreds of millions—where did all that money even go?!

sentences.zh: 特效也特别差。
sentences.en: The CGI was awful too.

sentences.zh: 其实演员演的还行，但是整个剧情都乱七八糟的。
sentences.en: The acting was actually decent, but the plot was completely all over the place.

sentences.zh: 看完我都不知道这个电影到底在讲什么。
sentences.en: By the time it ended, I honestly still had no clue what it was supposed to be about.

sentences.zh: 再也不想看这个导演的电影了。
sentences.en: I'm officially done watching movies by this director.

sentences.zh: 我们学院下周要办新生晚会，导员让我们积极报节目呢。
sentences.en: Our college is putting on a freshman talent show next week, and our advisor is encouraging us to sign up for performances.

sentences.zh: 但是我什么才艺都没有。
sentences.en: But I honestly don't have any talent at all.

sentences.zh: 我小时候其实上过不少兴趣班，但是都没坚持下来。
sentences.en: I actually took a bunch of after-school classes when I was a kid, but I never stuck with any of them.

sentences.zh: 我们班有人报了钢琴有人报了小提琴，还有人报了跳舞。
sentences.en: Some of my classmates signed up to play piano or violin, and others are doing dance numbers.

sentences.zh: 你说我表演个魔术怎么样？我可以在网上学个魔术。
sentences.en: What if I performed a magic trick? I could just learn one online.

sentences.zh: 或者演个小品？我还挺有幽默感的。
sentences.en: Or maybe do a skit? I like to think I'm pretty funny!

sentences.zh: 刚才我室友来找我，说想和我一起表演诗朗诵。
sentences.en: My roommate just asked if I wanted to do a poetry reading together.

sentences.zh: 我觉得诗朗诵不错耶，我普通话很标准。
sentences.en: I actually think a poetry reading is a solid idea—My Mandarin is really standard.

sentences.zh: 我们决定就表演诗朗诵了，现在就开始选诗。
sentences.en: We decided to go with the poetry reading—we're picking out a poem right now!

sentences.zh: 我今天去上了一节普拉提体验课，好累啊。
sentences.en: I took a Pilates trial class today—I am completely wiped out!

sentences.zh: 我以为我会很喜欢呢，因为我挺喜欢瑜伽的，我喜欢拉伸。
sentences.en: I thought I'd love it because I really like yoga, and I'm super into stretching.

sentences.zh: 不过我朋友说我应该报普拉提的私教课。
sentences.en: But my friend said I should sign up for 1-on-1 Pilates sessions instead.

sentences.zh: 她说私教课可以根据我的身体情况来，比小班课好。
sentences.en: She said 1-on-1 sessions are tailored to my body, which is way better than group classes.

sentences.zh: 那我再上一节普拉提私教课吧，还是不喜欢的话就算了。
sentences.en: I'll give a 1-on-1 session a shot—if I still don't like it, I'll just pass.

sentences.zh: 我买了一个团购的私教体验课，才59.9
sentences.en: I snagged a private trial class deal—it was only fifty-nine point nine kuai!

sentences.zh: 我已经约好了，明天晚上8点去上。
sentences.en: I'm all booked for tomorrow night at eight.

sentences.zh: 要是这次还是不喜欢，我就继续上我的瑜伽课了。
sentences.en: If it's still not my thing this time, I'll just stick with my yoga classes.

sentences.zh: 我上了一节吉他体验课，我觉得好难啊。
sentences.en: I took a guitar trial class today—it was so hard!

sentences.zh: 我看不懂乐谱，而且弹的我手指头疼。
sentences.en: I can't read sheet music, and my fingertips are killing me from pressing the strings.

sentences.zh: 要不我试试学尤克里里？好像简单点。
sentences.en: Maybe I should try the ukulele instead? It seems a lot easier.

sentences.zh: 我想至少学会弹一首歌。
sentences.en: I at least wanna learn to play one full song.

sentences.zh: 我男朋友下个月就要过生日了，我想弹给他听。
sentences.en: My boyfriend's birthday is next month—I wanna play a song for him.

sentences.zh: 不过我还没有想好学哪首歌呢，感觉我好像没什么学乐器的天赋。
sentences.en: But I haven't decided on a song yet. I don't think I have much talent for playing instruments.

sentences.zh: 我一个小学同学什么乐器都会，唱歌也特别好听，现在都发了两张专辑了。
sentences.en: One of my elementary school classmates can play pretty much any instrument and has an amazing voice—she's already dropped two albums!

sentences.zh: 虽然不是什么大明星，但是在我们老家还挺出名的呢。
sentences.en: She's not a huge celebrity or anything, but she's a big deal back in my hometown!

sentences.zh: 一会儿我要和朋友去公园打羽毛球。
sentences.en: I'm heading to the park with a friend to play badminton in a bit!

sentences.zh: 这个公园可好了，可以打羽毛球，网球，篮球，乒乓球，还可以踢足球，场地都是免费的。
sentences.en: This park is awesome—you can play badminton, tennis, basketball, ping-pong, and even soccer, and it's all free!

sentences.zh: 我们到啦，今天羽毛球场地都没有人耶。
sentences.en: We made it! Nobody's even using the badminton courts today.

sentences.zh: 妈呀，风也太大了，我刚发出去的球就给我吹回来了。
sentences.en: Oh my gosh, it is way too windy! I just served and the wind blew the shuttlecock right back to me.

sentences.zh: 不行，风实在太大了，我俩就在这捡球了。
sentences.en: Forget it, the wind is crazy—we're literally just gonna spend all day chasing the shuttlecock around.

sentences.zh: 怪不得今天没人打羽毛球呢。
sentences.en: Well, no wonder nobody's out here playing badminton today!

sentences.zh: 早知道去打网球了，但是我俩也没带球拍和球。
sentences.en: If I'd known, we would've played tennis instead, but we didn't bring any tennis rackets or balls.

sentences.zh: 算了，我们打算就在公园散散步了。
sentences.en: Oh well, we're just gonna take a stroll around the park instead.

sentences.zh: 我们下周要体测了。
sentences.en: We have our physical fitness test next week.

sentences.zh: 我决定从今天开始每天都去操场跑两圈。
sentences.en: I decided to run two laps on the track every single day starting today.

sentences.zh: 妈呀操场人好多呀。
sentences.en: Man, the track is so packed!

sentences.zh: 为啥我跑了一会儿就脚腕疼呢？
sentences.en: Why do my ankles hurt after running for like two minutes?

sentences.zh: 应该是我这个鞋不行，我这是个平板鞋，我得买双跑鞋。
sentences.en: It's gotta be my shoes—these are just regular sneakers. I need to get proper running shoes.

sentences.zh: 我先回宿舍休息了，等明天买了跑鞋再来跑。
sentences.en: I'm heading back to the dorm to rest—I'll come back to run tomorrow after I get running shoes.

sentences.zh: 刚碰到我们班长了他居然下个月要去跑马拉松。
sentences.en: I just ran into our class prez—turns out he's running a marathon next month!

sentences.zh: 太厉害了，我只要能过体测就谢天谢地了。
sentences.en: That's insane—I'll be happy if I just manage to pass the fitness test.

sentences.zh: 今天这个雾也太大了，感觉能见度都不到10米。
sentences.en: The fog is so thick today—I can barely see ten meters ahead.

sentences.zh: 也不知道到底是雾还是雾霾。
sentences.en: I honestly can't tell if it's actual fog or just straight-up smog.

sentences.zh: 最近天气真的太差了，要么阴天要么下雨要么大雾，啥时候才能有晴天啊。
sentences.en: The weather's been terrible lately—it's either overcast, raining, or super foggy. When are we gonna get some sunshine?!

sentences.zh: 估计是到了梅雨季了，我家里衣服被子都可潮了。
sentences.en: It must be the plum rain season—my clothes and bedding at home feel so damp.

sentences.zh: 冻死我了，我就穿了个短袖出来，我要回家拿个外套。
sentences.en: I'm freezing my butt off! I came out in just a T-shirt, so I gotta head home and grab a jacket.

sentences.zh: 哇雾散了，天居然晴了耶！太不容易了。
sentences.en: Whoa, the fog cleared up—it actually turned sunny! It's about time!

sentences.zh: 我要出去晒晒太阳，我都快发霉了。
sentences.en: I'm gonna go get some sun—I feel like I'm literally growing mold here.

sentences.zh: 天气预报说明天有龙卷风呢。
sentences.en: The forecast says there's a tornado warning for tomorrow.

sentences.zh: 我刚去超市买了好多吃的，龙卷风的时候可不能出门。
sentences.en: I just went to the store and stocked up on food—you definitely can't step foot outside during a tornado.

sentences.zh: 我把我的电动车也推回家了，万一龙卷风把我电动车吹走了咋办。
sentences.en: I even brought my e-bike inside—what if the tornado blows it away?

sentences.zh: 去年有一次沙尘暴，我正好在外面，回家的时候我一身都是土。
sentences.en: There was a dust storm last year and I happened to be outside—I came home covered in dirt!

sentences.zh: 我爸今天把窗户都加固了一下，怕明天龙卷风把窗户吹破了。
sentences.en: My dad reinforced all the windows today, just in case the tornado blows them out.

sentences.zh: 今天倒是没有大风，只有一点微风。
sentences.en: There aren't any strong winds today though—just a light breeze.

sentences.zh: 天上都是乌云，一会儿应该有阵雨。
sentences.en: The sky's full of dark clouds—it'll probably shower in a bit.

sentences.zh: 希望我们都能平安度过明天。
sentences.en: Hopefully we all make it through tomorrow safe and sound!

sentences.zh: 好喜欢秋天呀，秋天真是最舒服的季节。
sentences.en: I love fall so much—it's honestly the most comfortable season!

sentences.zh: 不冷也不热，紫外线也不强。
sentences.en: It's not too hot, not too cold, and the sun isn't too harsh either.

sentences.zh: 而且路上有好多落叶，感觉自己像在电影里一样。
sentences.en: Plus, with all the fallen leaves on the streets, I feel like I'm in a movie!

sentences.zh: 今天天气也好好，天特别蓝，云也很好看。
sentences.en: The weather today is amazing too—the sky is so blue, and the clouds look incredible.

sentences.zh: 可惜北京的秋天特别短，舒服不了多久就入冬了。
sentences.en: Too bad fall in Beijing is blink-and-you'll-miss-it short—it barely lasts before winter sets in.

sentences.zh: 我买的秋装都穿不了几天。
sentences.en: I barely get to wear all the fall outfits I bought before it gets too cold!

sentences.zh: 哇！出晚霞了！太美了！
sentences.en: Woah, Look at those sunset colors! It's so gorgeous!

sentences.zh: 明天肯定也是个好天气。
sentences.en: Tomorrow is definitely gonna be another gorgeous day.

sentences.zh: 今天超市搞活动，满200减70呢。
sentences.en: The supermarket's running a promo today—spend two hundred and get seventy off!

sentences.zh: 我现在推了个购物车在选东西。
sentences.en: I'm wheeling a cart around right now picking stuff out.

sentences.zh: 我拿了两桶油，这两桶油就快200了。
sentences.en: I grabbed two jugs of cooking oil—these two alone are almost two hundred bucks!

sentences.zh: 哦我还可以买点盐巴耗油鸡精什么的，反正也不怕放。
sentences.en: Oh, I can also grab some salt, oyster sauce, and chicken bouillon—they have a long shelf life anyway.

sentences.zh: 面粉我也拿了一袋。
sentences.en: I grabbed a bag of flour too.

sentences.zh: 有牛奶做活动一箱才14块8，不过还有10天就过期了。
sentences.en: There's milk on sale for just fourteen point eight kuai a case, but it expires in ten days.

sentences.zh: 我没有买，我乳糖不耐受。
sentences.en: I passed on it—I'm lactose intolerant.

sentences.zh: 我买了好多草莓，但是找不到称水果的地方在哪呢。
sentences.en: I grabbed a bunch of strawberries, but I can't find the weighing station anywhere.

sentences.zh: 天呐收银台排队的人都快排到法国了。
sentences.en: Oh my god, the checkout line goes all the way to France!

sentences.zh: 我去自助收银那边吧，那边人稍微少一点。
sentences.en: I'm gonna hit the self-checkout instead—looks a bit less packed over there.

sentences.zh: 我在网上买了条低腰牛仔裤，穿上好好看呀。
sentences.en: I bought a pair of low-rise jeans online and they look so good on me!

sentences.zh: 就是肚脐眼露在外面，我肚子有点冷。
sentences.en: But my belly button is out in the open, so my stomach feels a little chilly.

sentences.zh: 但如果搭配一个长一点的T恤就不太好看了。
sentences.en: But if I pair them with a longer tee, it totally ruins the look.

sentences.zh: 算了，我等天再热一点再穿吧，这个牛仔裤还是短裤，我腿也有点冷。
sentences.en: Forget it, I'll just wait until it gets warmer—they're actually denim shorts, so my legs are freezing too.

sentences.zh: 我现在换了一条高腰的长裤，暖和多了。
sentences.en: I just changed into a pair of high-waisted pants—so much warmer!

sentences.zh: 这条裤子配高跟鞋可好看了。
sentences.en: These pants look amazing with heels!

sentences.zh: 我又找了一条红色的腰带配这条裤子。
sentences.en: I picked out a red belt to go with them.

sentences.zh: 裤子是蓝色的，腰带和高跟鞋都是红色的，配起来超好看。
sentences.en: Blue pants with a red belt and matching red heels—this combo is so fire!

sentences.zh: 我觉得自己有个毛病就是特别容易纠结，
sentences.en: I have this bad habit where I'm super indecisive.

sentences.zh: 昨天我在商场看上个杯子，两个颜色，一个橘黄色一个大红色。我纠结了一下午，最后都没买。
sentences.en: Yesterday I saw a mug at the mall that came in orange and bright red. I spent all afternoon debating it and ended up walking away with nothing.

sentences.zh: 也可能是因为太穷了，要是有钱我就两个都买了。
sentences.en: Or maybe I'm just broke—if I had the money, I would've just bought both!

sentences.zh: 其实也不算很贵，45块钱一个。
sentences.en: It wasn't even that pricey, though—forty-five bucks each.

sentences.zh: 其实我都挺喜欢的，要不我今天再去店里把两个都买了？
sentences.en: I honestly like them both, so maybe I should just go back today and grab both?

sentences.zh: 行，我一会儿就去。
sentences.en: Alright, I'll head over in a bit.

sentences.zh: 啊啊啊太开心了！老板说今天店庆，全场5折！
sentences.en: Ahhh, I am so hyped! The owner said they're having an anniversary sale today, so everything is half off!

sentences.zh: 我真的太幸运了！45块钱就把两个喜欢的杯子都买上了！
sentences.en: I am so lucky! I got both of the mugs I wanted for just forty-five yuan!

sentences.zh: 明天是我最好的朋友Emma的生日，我要给她买个礼物。
sentences.en: Tomorrow is my best friend Emma's birthday—I gotta get her a gift!

sentences.zh: 我现在在逛精品店呢，东西好多啊，都不知道买什么。
sentences.en: I'm browsing a gift shop right now, and there's so much stuff that I have zero idea what to pick.

sentences.zh: 她很喜欢毛绒玩具，但是我前几年都是送的她毛绒玩具，今年我要送点不一样的。
sentences.en: She loves plushies, but I've been giving her those for years, so I wanna mix it up this time.

sentences.zh: 我选了一个超级可爱的摆件。
sentences.en: I ended up picking out this super cute figurine!

sentences.zh: 老板帮我包的好漂亮呀，还打了个蝴蝶结。
sentences.en: The owner wrapped it up so beautifully with a cute little bow on top.

sentences.zh: 虽然包装额外收了15块钱，但是也是很值得了
sentences.en: Even though the gift wrapping was an extra fifteen bucks, it was totally worth it.

sentences.zh: 我还要去蛋糕店定个玫瑰花形状的蛋糕。
sentences.en: Now I gotta head over to the bakery to order a rose-shaped cake.

sentences.zh: 定好啦，明天Emma一定会很开心。
sentences.en: All set! Emma is gonna be so thrilled tomorrow!

sentences.zh: 我在网上买了一件毛衣，刚才到了，这个色差也太大了。
sentences.en: I bought a sweater online and it just arrived—the color is way off!

sentences.zh: 我在网上看的是粉红色，收到的是桃红色。
sentences.en: It looked like a soft pink online, but what I got is hot pink.

sentences.zh: 以后还是得去实体店买衣服。
sentences.en: I really need to shop in stores from now on.

sentences.zh: 但是现在商场的服装店都超级贵，随便一件毛衣都要四五百。
sentences.en: But store prices in malls are so crazy expensive now—any random sweater easily costs four or five hundred bucks!

sentences.zh: 而且质量也不好，甚至很多品牌你听都没听说过。
sentences.en: And the quality isn't even that good—plus, half of them are brands you've never even heard of!

sentences.zh: 算了还是在线上买吧，以后买之前多看看评价。
sentences.en: Whatever, I'll stick to online shopping—I just need to actually read the reviews before buying next time.

sentences.zh: 评价里好多人说有色差呢，我买之前都没仔细看。
sentences.en: Tons of reviews mentioned the color being off—I just didn't read them carefully before ordering.

sentences.zh: 我要把这个退了。
sentences.en: I'm definitely returning this.

sentences.zh: 我刚试了一条连衣裙还挺好看的，是那种比较宽松的。
sentences.en: I just tried on a dress and it's super cute—it has a loose, flowy fit.

sentences.zh: 我本来想买个修身一点的，但是这个宽松的居然也挺显瘦。
sentences.en: I was originally looking for something more fitted, but this relaxed fit is surprisingly slimming!

sentences.zh: 不过你说会不会是因为试衣间的镜子把人照瘦了呢？
sentences.en: Do you think it's just because fitting room mirrors make everyone look thinner, though?

sentences.zh: 我听说好多商家都会买这种把人照瘦的镜子。
sentences.en: I heard a lot of stores use those slimming mirrors on purpose.

sentences.zh: 我刚让朋友用手机帮我拍了个照片，确实挺好看的耶。
sentences.en: I just had my friend take a quick picture on her phone—it actually looks really good!

sentences.zh: 店员说今天有活动呢，买两件打6折。
sentences.en: The store associate said there's a promo today—forty percent off if you buy two!

sentences.zh: 我买了两条这个连衣裙，不同颜色的，一个灰色一个棕色。
sentences.en: So I got two of the same dress in different colors—one grey and one brown.

sentences.zh: 一共才238块8，太划算了。
sentences.en: The total came to just two hundred thirty-eight point eight kuai—what a total steal!

sentences.zh: 我今天在商场买了三个内衣三个内裤还有两套睡衣。
sentences.en: I bought three bras, three pairs of undies, and two sets of pajamas at the mall today.

sentences.zh: 有个内衣是带钢圈的，但是很好看。
sentences.en: One of the bras is underwired, but it's super cute.

sentences.zh: 我以前一直不能接受带钢圈的内衣，但这个实在太好看了。
sentences.en: I used to never be able to stand underwire bras, but this one was just way too pretty to pass up!

sentences.zh: 不知道是不是我变瘦了的原因，以前都是买C罩杯的，今天穿上居然都大了，最后买的三个都是B的。
sentences.en: I don't know if it's because I lost weight, but I used to be a C cup—today those were all too big on me, so I ended up buying three B-cup bras.

sentences.zh: 我买的睡衣也特别好看，一套是真丝的，一套是纯棉的。
sentences.en: The pajamas I got are super cute too—one set is silk and the other is 100% cotton.

sentences.zh: 反正我试了一下，穿上都是又舒服又好看。
sentences.en: Either way, I tried them on and they're both super comfy and flattering!

sentences.zh: 而且因为我在这个商场有积分，抵扣了200多块钱呢。
sentences.en: Plus, I had reward points at the mall that knocked over two hundred bucks off the total!

sentences.zh: 我现在要把这些都洗一下。
sentences.en: I'm gonna wash everything before I wear it.

sentences.zh: 我前天在直播间买了一箱苹果，今天到了。
sentences.en: I bought a box of apples off a livestream the day before yesterday, and they just showed up today.

sentences.zh: 真的气死我了，跟直播间看到的一点都不一样。
sentences.en: I'm so pissed off—they look nothing like what was on the livestream!

sentences.zh: 当时那个主播展示的苹果特别大特别红，我这个又小又青。
sentences.en: The streamer was showing off these huge, bright red apples, but mine came in tiny and green.

sentences.zh: 我刚尝了一下，酸死了，那个主播当时说是纯甜无酸的。
sentences.en: I just bit into one and it's sour as hell—the streamer swore they were super sweet with zero tartness!

sentences.zh: 又被坑了，上次我买菠萝也是，收到的又小又酸。
sentences.en: Ripped off again! Same thing happened when I bought pineapples last time—they showed up small and super sour too.

sentences.zh: 我刚想去给他们差评，结果这个苹果居然下架了。
sentences.en: I was just about to leave a bad review, the listing's already gone.

sentences.zh: 我现在也退不了，因为不支持7天无理由退货。
sentences.en: I can't even return them now because they don't offer seven-day no-questions-asked returns.

sentences.zh: 我要跟平台举报这个商家还有这个主播！
sentences.en: I am definitely reporting both the seller and the streamer to the platform!

episodes.title: 购物节囤卫生纸卫生巾

sentences.zh: 今天是购物节，在网上买东西可便宜了，但是我都不知道买啥。
sentences.en: It's the shopping festival today and things are super cheap online, but I have no idea what to buy.

sentences.zh: 啊我可以买卫生纸餐巾纸卫生巾这些，反正以后肯定是要用的。
sentences.en: Oh, I can stock up on toilet paper, tissues, and pads—I'm definitely gonna use them anyway.

sentences.zh: 我刚买了两箱卫生巾，日用的夜用的，护垫，安睡裤全都买了。
sentences.en: I just bought two boxes of pads—got daytime, overnight, pantyliners, and period underwear, the whole deal.

sentences.zh: 还买了3包卫生纸，纸巾也买了两箱。
sentences.en: Also picked up three packs of toilet paper and two cases of tissues.

sentences.zh: 啊我还可以买点保鲜膜保鲜袋垃圾袋之类的。
sentences.en: Oh, I could also grab some plastic wrap, food storage bags, and trash bags.

sentences.zh: 买好了。
sentences.en: All set!

sentences.zh: 其实我购物车里还有一个游戏机我可想买了，但是今天居然一点都没有降价。
sentences.en: Honestly, there's a gaming console sitting in my cart that I've been dying to get, but it didn't drop in price at all today.

sentences.zh: 可能是新出的，还不到降价的时间吧。
sentences.en: It's probably brand new, so it's way too early for a price drop.

sentences.zh: 算了这个我还是先不买了，要2000多呢，过两个月再买。
sentences.en: Whatever, I'll hold off on that—it's over two grand. I'll get it in a couple of months.

episodes.title: 蓝牙耳机还是有线耳机

sentences.zh: 我耳机又坏了，这已经是我这半年来买的第三个耳机了。
sentences.en: My earbuds broke again—this is literally my third pair in six months!

sentences.zh: 第一个耳机是丢了一只，第二个耳机是耳机仓丢了，这个是从耳朵上掉下来被我不小心踩了一脚。
sentences.en: With the first pair, I lost an earbud. With the second, I lost the charging case. And this one fell out of my ear and I accidentally stepped on it.

sentences.zh: 我就不适合用蓝牙耳机，我要买个有线耳机用。
sentences.en: Wireless earbuds and I just aren't meant to be—I'm sticking to wired earbuds from now on.

sentences.zh: 不过很麻烦的是，现在的手机都只有一个插孔，我插上耳机就不能充电了。
sentences.en: But the super annoying thing is, phones nowadays only have one port, so I can't charge my phone while my earbuds are plugged in.

sentences.zh: 奥对，我可以买个转换头就可以一边插充电器一边插耳机了。
sentences.en: Oh wait, I can just buy an adapter! That way I can plug in the charger and my earbuds at the same time.

sentences.zh: 我还要再换个插头和数据线，现在这个充电器充电可慢了。
sentences.en: I also need to replace my charging brick and cable—this one charges way too slowly.

sentences.zh: 妈耶一个插头要60块钱，怎么不去抢劫！
sentences.en: Holy crap, sixty kuai for a charging brick?! What a total rip-off!
